steps.short: Assign, chase and check the bookkeepers' filing and recording work and send record packages to auditor and tax.
steps.what: Assign close and filing tasks to bookkeepers and track progress
reasons: hands off to Bookkeeper (accounts payable and receivable)
steps.design: Replace the Excel close checklist and the mail chasing with a Microsoft Lists close tracker plus a nightly Python check on the AFAS extract. The check flags bookings without a document, unprocessed agency invoices and late approvals, and sends Teams reminders to the owner. A Power BI page shows close status by site. A small answer desk over the SharePoint procedures handles routine questions. Record packages for the auditor are compiled from the PBC list, and an accountant sends them.

steps.short: Tell applicants where their application stands, by mail and by phone, including rejections.
steps.what: Answer replies asking why or what next

loop.input: candidate reply plus screening note and stage history
loop.output: draft reply in the recruiter's tone
loop.check: Draft may only state reasons recorded in the screening note; recruiter edits and sends
loop.stop: One draft; sensitive replies (complaints, discrimination claims, AVG requests) are flagged and not drafted
loop.why_not_simpler: Replies are free text; templates handle the first message but not follow-ups.

steps.design: Configure Recruitee to send templated emails on stage changes, with automatic sends for receipt and early-stage rejections after the recruiter's stage move, and recruiter review for post-interview messages. A daily job flags candidates with no contact for five working days in a Teams list. Follow-up replies get a cited draft; post-interview rejections stay a phone call.

steps.short: Keep the chart of accounts and coding rules in AFAS, code unclear entries, and fix miscodings.
steps.what: Code invoices and entries the bookkeepers could not assign
reasons: hands off to Bookkeeper (accounts payable and receivable)

loop.input: Invoice lines with supplier, description and amount, plus 24 months of coding history
loop.output: Ledger account, cost centre and VAT code with a reason
loop.check: Code checks the account and cost centre are active, the VAT code fits supplier country and reverse charge, and the choice matches history; mismatches go to the queue
loop.stop: One pass per line; anything below the confidence threshold or over EUR 10,000 goes to the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: Unclear lines are the ones the supplier default rule already failed on; only the free-text description tells the cost type

steps.design: Configure AFAS supplier defaults as the first line of coding. A nightly Python job on the governed data platform runs outlier tests over every ledger line (account against supplier history, VAT code against country, cost centre against site). A bounded model step proposes codes for the lines the defaults miss. The accountant works one Power BI exception page and approves reclasses, which post to AFAS through the UpdateConnector.

steps.short: Record attendance, collect evaluations and report on whether training works.
steps.what: Compare training with onboarding, 90-day retention and certification outcomes
steps.design: Studytube session check-in by QR code replaces paper lists, and the nightly AFAS extract plus a Studytube feed land in a Power BI L&D page showing week-one onboarding, first-shift certification and 90-day retention by course and site. A bounded model step clusters anonymised comments at group level only, and the quarterly report is generated from the dashboard for the specialist to edit.

steps.short: Reconcile cost-centre budgets to site and company totals and track the contingency reserve.
steps.what: Track contingency reserve draws and reallocations
steps.design: Hold the cost-centre hierarchy as a maintained dimension in AFAS or a small governed mapping table instead of an Excel tab. A scheduled Python job reconciles every sub-budget to its site and company total after each AFAS refresh, lists breaks, and keeps a contingency register in a SharePoint list or small app. Approved transfers are posted to AFAS through its update connector after the controller signs off.

steps.short: Search employee files in AFAS and old documents to answer requests and prepare personnel actions.
steps.what: Compile the answer or statement, such as a werkgeversverklaring
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Requests come in through an AFAS workflow form instead of mail. A deterministic job pulls contract history from AFAS, computes chain-rule and CAO checks, and fills standard statements from templates. A bounded extraction loop reads only non-medical scanned documents and flags mismatches. The administrator approves anything that leaves the company.

steps.short: Key debits and credits into AFAS and total accounts in Excel to check they balance.
steps.what: Export balances and total accounts in Excel to check
steps.design: Replace hand keying with a fixed Excel journal template that a script validates (balanced, valid accounts, cost centres, VAT codes) and posts through the AFAS import connector as unapproved entries for a second person to release. Recurring entries move into AFAS periodic journals, and the Excel totalling is replaced by a Power BI balance check page on the nightly AFAS extract.

steps.short: Assign ledger account, cost centre and VAT code to transactions and summarise records for the close.
steps.what: Build summaries of costs per site and open items in Excel
steps.design: Set supplier default coding in AFAS for fixed suppliers and add a bounded model step that suggests coding for the rest, checked against an allowed-account table and VAT rules, with the bookkeeper confirming. Bank lines and costs are booked by AFAS bank rules, and the Excel summaries become a Power BI page per site on the nightly extract, with drill-down to the coded line and the reason.

steps.short: Watch cash position, reserves, tax and covenant deadlines daily so the company stays liquid and compliant.
steps.what: Download bank statements and AFAS balances into Excel
steps.design: Replace the daily Excel cash sheet with a scheduled job on the governed data platform that loads Rabobank CAMT.053 statements and AFAS open items, and feeds a Power BI cash and 13-week dashboard. Deterministic rules raise Teams alerts for reserve floors, covenant ratios and VAT and loonheffing payment dates; a bounded model step proposes matches for bank lines AFAS rules leave unmatched and drafts the weekly cash note.

steps.short: Plan the HR year: training, certificates, works council and union agenda, HR budget with Finance.
steps.what: Prepare works council and union dossiers, cost CAO demands
reasons: hands off to Finance Director, another team

loop.input: union demand letters and FNV/CNV publications
loop.output: structured list of demands with parameters (percent, effective date, scope)
loop.check: director confirms each extracted parameter; costing runs in deterministic code on AFAS payroll data
loop.stop: one extraction pass; unclear demands flagged for manual entry
loop.why_not_simpler: demands arrive as prose letters; the costing itself is plain code

steps.design: Configure Studytube expiry alerts and a Power BI certificate page joined to AFAS rosters so forklift and VCA gaps reach shift leads before they lapse. A Python costing model on the governed data platform prices CAO demands and budget scenarios from AFAS payroll and agency hours, with a bounded extraction step reading union demand letters; the director keeps the plan, the OR consultation and the bargaining.

steps.short: Register, match, code and get approval for supplier and agency invoices, then prepare the payment batch.
steps.what: Chase budget holders by mail for invoice approval
steps.design: Configure AFAS invoice scanning and approval workflows so invoices arrive registered and route to budget holders without mail. A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform matches invoices to orders and agency hours, with a bounded model step for messy agency lines, and runs duplicate and IBAN-change tests before the batch. The payment batch is still released in Rabobank by two people.

steps.short: Match bank, ledger and agency invoice lines; chase and report what does not match.
steps.what: Reconcile AP and AR subledgers and agency invoices against ledger and hours
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: Turn on and tune AFAS bank matching with tolerances, and replace the reconciliation Excel sheets with a scheduled Python job on a governed data platform that reads AFAS open items, ledger balances and the three agency portals' hours and invoices. A bounded model step proposes matches for leftover bank lines; everything that stays unmatched lands in one queue and a Power BI page the controller reads at close.

steps.short: Track training spend against budget and write reports that justify the cost to HR and finance.
steps.what: Collect training invoices, licence costs and course fees
steps.design: Replace the training-cost Excel file with a nightly job on the governed data platform that pulls training-related invoices and ledger lines from AFAS and enrolments from Studytube, allocates them by rules plus a small classification loop for unclear invoice lines, and feeds a Power BI training-spend page next to the existing HR dashboards. Each quarter a generator drafts the budget report from the same tables; the specialist edits it and the controller sees the same numbers.

steps.short: Type employee changes (address, earnings, absence, production, performance notes, exit dates and reasons) into AFAS.
steps.what: Check records before payroll cut-off and correct errors
steps.design: Employees change their own address and bank details in AFAS InSite/Pocket, managers report absence and exits in AFAS workflows with mandatory reason codes, so typing disappears. A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform loads site production figures into AFAS and runs validation rules before each payroll cut-off; breaks appear on a Power BI exception page and in a daily mail to the administrator.

steps.short: Set weekly priorities for the 13-person HR team, chase status, approve exceptions, coach direct reports.
steps.what: Write monthly HR update for the management team
reasons: hands off to Finance Director, another team

loop.input: HR metric extract with month-on-month changes and the director's short notes
loop.output: two-page MT update draft
loop.check: all figures inserted by code from the metric layer; model text may not contain numbers not in the extract; director reads before sending
loop.stop: one draft plus up to two regenerations; on failure fall back to the fixed template with figures only
loop.why_not_simpler: the explanation of why metrics moved is free text that a template cannot write

steps.design: Replace the Excel tracker and the status mail round with a Power BI team-workload page fed nightly from AFAS (absence cases, mutations), Recruitee (open vacancies, stage age) and Studytube (overdue certificates), plus Teams notifications when an item breaches its agreed age. Exceptions run through configured AFAS workflow approvals with CAO-table pre-checks, and a small drafting step writes the MT update around code-inserted figures.

steps.short: Build, schedule, run and score applicant tests such as forklift practicals and reading tests; check they work.
steps.what: Schedule tests and invite candidates by mail
steps.design: Configure Recruitee self-scheduling and templates for test invites; a tablet form (Microsoft Forms or a small Power App) scores multiple-choice and practical checklists by code and writes the result into Recruitee for recruiter sign-off. A Power BI page links test results to AFAS 90-day retention; a bounded model step only drafts new question items for human review.

steps.short: Tick AFAS reports against Excel side-lists and journals, find differences and correct them.
steps.what: Investigate and explain unmatched lines

loop.input: Unmatched line with nearby candidate lines, invoice text and supplier history
loop.output: Likely cause (timing, rounding, wrong account, missing invoice) with the candidate line ids
loop.check: Each suggested candidate must exist in the AFAS data and its amounts must add up to the difference; otherwise it is dropped
loop.stop: One pass per line, at most three candidates; if no candidate passes the check the line goes to the bookkeeper unexplained
loop.why_not_simpler: Rules catch exact and tolerance matches; the rest needs reading free-text descriptions and invoice references that vary per supplier.

steps.design: Move the Excel side-lists (accruals, manual journals, agency hours) into a small governed app or AFAS free tables, then run a nightly Python job on the data platform that pulls AFAS connectors and agency portal exports and matches them by rule. A bounded model step suggests causes for unmatched lines, and a Power BI exception page shows the bookkeeper only what is left.

steps.short: Log call outcomes, promises to pay, disputes and customer credit facts in Excel tracker and AFAS notes.
steps.what: Compile weekly collections status for Controller and sales
steps.design: Replace the Excel collections tracker with a small case app on the governed data platform that reads AFAS open items through the API and writes notes back to AFAS debtor records. A bounded model step turns call notes into structured outcomes the officer confirms; a nightly job checks KvK changes and insurer limits; the Power BI finance model gets a collections page instead of the weekly mail.

steps.short: Review balance sheet and profit and loss accounts each month for errors and unusual movements.
steps.what: Reconcile balance sheet accounts to sub-ledgers, bank and agency portals
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the data platform reconciles every balance sheet account to AFAS sub-ledgers, Rabobank CAMT.053 statements and agency portal invoices, and a Power BI close dashboard shows breaks and movements above threshold. The accountant works only the flagged accounts and proposes adjusting entries; the controller approves them before posting in AFAS.

steps.short: Answer shipper mails and calls about invoices, statements, delivery proof and disputed charges.
steps.what: Handle disputes: ask sales or operations, request credit note
reasons: hands off to Bookkeeper (accounts payable and receivable)
steps.design: Put a bounded classifier on the shared debtors mailbox that tags requests and invoice numbers, after which deterministic code pulls statements and invoice copies from AFAS and proof of delivery from SharePoint and sends standard replies from templates. Explanations get a model draft for approval, and disputes open a case in the collections app that routes to sales or operations and to a bookkeeper for credit notes.

steps.short: Calculate and book month-end accruals, prepayments, deferrals and corrections in AFAS, with support for the controller.
steps.what: Pull trial balance, open purchase orders and agency hours not yet invoiced
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform pulls the AFAS trial balance, open purchase orders and agency hours. It applies a versioned accrual rule table and writes a balanced journal batch with a tie-out workbook. A bounded model step drafts the one-off entries and memos from contracts and mails. The controller approves the batch in a simple review screen, which then posts it to AFAS through the UpdateConnector.

steps.short: Design ways to track employee satisfaction and run grievance and complaint procedures, with the works council.
steps.what: Draft survey design or grievance procedure text

loop.input: current procedure, CAO clauses, SER advice and the signal overview
loop.output: draft procedure or survey questions with a list of choices for the OR
loop.check: HRBP and HR director review; a checklist confirms an anonymous route, response times and an appeal option
loop.stop: one draft plus two revisions; the HRBP finishes it by hand after that
loop.why_not_simpler: each procedure is new text fitted to Noordhaven's sites and CAO; templates give only the skeleton

steps.design: Replace the complaint mailbox and Excel list with a restricted SharePoint grievance register fed by a Microsoft Forms intake, with Power Automate routing, response-time reminders and an appeal step. A Power BI page on the nightly AFAS extract combines absence, turnover and register counts per site, with a minimum group size so nobody is identifiable; a bounded drafting step helps write the procedure and survey for OR review.

steps.short: Check aging, loan and lease schedules and supplier terms so that payments in and out are up to date.
steps.what: Follow up with collections, controller or approvers
reasons: hands off to Credit and Collections Officer
steps.design: Build a Power BI page on the nightly AFAS extract with AP and AR aging, loan and lease instalments matched to bank lines, and invoices stuck in approval near the 30-day limit. A scheduled job sends a Teams message to the right owner (collections, approver or controller) for each new flag, so the tracking sheet goes away.

steps.short: Assign, chase and check the bookkeepers' filing and recording work and send record packages to auditor and tax.
steps.what: Chase missing invoices, receipts, approvals and agency hours
reasons: hands off to Bookkeeper (accounts payable and receivable)
steps.design: Replace the Excel close checklist and the mail chasing with a Microsoft Lists close tracker plus a nightly Python check on the AFAS extract. The check flags bookings without a document, unprocessed agency invoices and late approvals, and sends Teams reminders to the owner. A Power BI page shows close status by site. A small answer desk over the SharePoint procedures handles routine questions. Record packages for the auditor are compiled from the PBC list, and an accountant sends them.

steps.short: Pull HR data, find causes of turnover, absence and hiring problems, recommend policy changes.
steps.what: Request extracts from AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and agency portals
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Recruitee + Studytube + Staffing agency portals
hands off to People Analytics and HRIS Analyst
steps.design: Extend the nightly AFAS extract into a governed metric layer that also loads Recruitee stages, Studytube completions and agency hours, and publish fixed Power BI pages for the North Star: hire-to-day-90 retention, time to hire, week-one onboarding and verzuim by site, shift and agency. A bounded classification step tags pseudonymised exit comments into fixed themes; the director keeps the reading of causes and the recommendation.

steps.short: Check each supplier and agency invoice against the order, goods receipt or hours, then record it in AFAS.
steps.what: Check agency invoices against portal hours and split the g-rekening share
reasons: connects Staffing agency portals + AFAS Profit
steps.design: Switch on AFAS Profit UBL intake, Scan & herken and line-level three-way matching with set tolerances, so one-to-one matches are posted and released for approval without a touch. A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads agency portal hours, checks agency invoices, proposes the g-rekening split and posts only differences to a review queue. A small model step classifies the remaining exceptions and drafts the query for the bookkeeper to send.

steps.short: Check nightly refresh, chase late data, send reports and manage who sees which dashboard.
steps.what: Send reports and extracts to managers by mail or Teams
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: A scheduled job checks the extract and refresh each morning, runs data checks (missing end dates, open sick reports, unknown cost centres) and posts failures to a Teams channel and a status banner on the dashboards. Power BI subscriptions replace mailed reports, and row-level security is driven by the AFAS manager hierarchy, with a daily diff of access changes the analyst approves.

steps.short: Write and update manuals, handouts, slides and e-learning from work instructions and safety rules.
steps.what: Subject expert and safety lead review and sign off
reasons: comes in from outside the company
steps.design: A SharePoint library holds approved work instructions; Studytube AI Authoring turns them into course drafts and quizzes, and a bounded translation step with a fixed safety glossary produces plain Dutch, English and Polish versions. A Power Automate flow routes drafts to the safety lead for sign-off, then publishes to Studytube and flags courses whose source instruction changed.

steps.short: Plan how to fill current and seasonal staffing needs per site and role.
steps.what: Write plan and present it to HR Director and site managers

loop.input: Dashboard figures and the recruiter's strategy notes
loop.output: Plan document and slide draft per site
loop.check: Numbers inserted by code from the dashboard, not by the model; recruiter edits text
loop.stop: One draft plus one revision; else recruiter writes
loop.why_not_simpler: The narrative differs per site and season; numbers are templated but the argument is not

steps.design: Replace the Excel sheet that ties AFAS headcount, Recruitee vacancies and agency orders with a nightly job on the governed data platform feeding a Power BI staffing-demand page per site and week. The recruiter decides the strategy; a bounded model step drafts the plan text around figures inserted by code.

steps.short: Build the monthly management pack from AFAS, explain variances and present it to management.
steps.what: Analyse variances against budget and prior year, write commentary

loop.input: Variances above threshold with the top journal lines and descriptions behind each
loop.output: One or two sentence draft explanation per variance, citing the journal lines used
loop.check: Every amount in the text must match a computed figure; every cited line must exist; unexplained variances flagged
loop.stop: One pass per variance, one retry on a failed check, else marked 'needs explanation' for the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations come from free-text journal descriptions and invoice lines that rules cannot summarise

steps.design: Replace the Excel pack with a scheduled Python job on the governed data platform that reads the AFAS extract, applies a versioned account mapping and builds the pack and a Power BI page each night after close. A bounded model step drafts variance commentary from journal lines with a tie-out check; the accountant edits and the controller approves before it goes to management.

steps.short: Process hires, exits, leave, transfers and promotions in AFAS, with contract letters and notifications.
steps.what: Draft contract or letter from SharePoint template and send for signature
steps.design: A Recruitee-to-AFAS connector and an AFAS manager form start every personnel action as one AFAS workflow. Deterministic checks (CAO scale, ketenregeling, notice period, approvals present) run in code, the change is prepared in AFAS for one-click approval, the contract is merged from the SharePoint template, and notifications and Studytube enrolments go out automatically.

steps.short: Design and run development programmes that grow warehouse and office staff into team lead and management roles.
steps.what: Design the programme: modules, mentoring, job rotations, timing

loop.input: Development needs, competence profile for the target role, existing Studytube catalogue
loop.output: Draft programme outline with module list and reuse of existing courses
loop.check: Specialist reviews; every module must map to a competence in the profile
loop.stop: One draft plus up to two revisions per request; then manual design
loop.why_not_simpler: Turning loose needs into a structured outline is writing work; a template alone gives empty boxes.

steps.design: Keep selection and delivery human. Use Studytube AI Authoring and a drafting step in Microsoft 365 to produce programme outlines and modules from the competence profile, and a Power BI page that follows participants' completion, promotion and retention at group level with a comment-clustering step for feedback. A feedback-practice copilot can support new team leads, disclosed as AI.

steps.short: Build cost-benefit cases for investments, financing and operating choices, such as forklift lease versus buy or flex versus own staff.
steps.what: Write the recommendation memo with options for the Finance Director

loop.input: model outputs, scenario table and agreed assumptions
loop.output: memo with two or three options, their numbers, risks and open points; no single answer forced
loop.check: a script matches every figure in the memo to the model output; the analyst writes the recommendation line
loop.stop: one draft and one regeneration; a failed figure check blocks release
loop.why_not_simpler: the narrative changes per case; the figures and charts are generated by code

steps.design: A standard cost-benefit template in Python on the governed data platform, with fixed rules for discount rate, depreciation, tax and CAO labour cost, fed by scheduled pulls of the AFAS ledger and agency hours and invoices. A bounded model loop extracts supplier and lease quotes and drafts the options memo; Power BI shows scenarios to the requester, and the Finance Director decides.

steps.short: Review AFAS, bank and agency-portal processes and recommend controls that keep financial data reliable.
steps.what: Test segregation of duties, IBAN changes, duplicate payments, interface breaks
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Rabobank + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: Nightly deterministic tests on the governed data platform run over every AFAS mutation, payment batch, CAMT.053 statement and agency invoice (segregation of duties, IBAN changes, duplicates, unmatched agency hours) and feed a Power BI exception dashboard. Findings are drafted by a bounded model step and tracked in a SharePoint list; walkthroughs and the advice stay with the accountant.

steps.short: Plan training sessions around rooms, forklifts, instructors and shift rosters, then book and enrol people.
steps.what: Collect who needs which course: expiring certificates, new starters, requests
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads Studytube expiry dates and enrolments, AFAS employee and site data, the shift roster and Outlook resource calendars for rooms, forklifts and instructors, and proposes a session plan per site. The L&D specialist approves or edits it in a small planning app; approved sessions are created in Studytube with Outlook invites, and team leads get a notice of who is released when. No model is needed at run time.

steps.short: Analyse actuals, forecasts and cash to judge Noordhaven's current and future financial position for management and board.
steps.what: Pull AFAS ledger, AR/AP, agency hours and bank balances into Excel
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals + Rabobank
steps.design: Replace the FP&A Excel workbook that ties AFAS, the agency portals and Rabobank with a nightly Python job on a governed data platform. It feeds a Power BI rolling forecast and variance dashboard. A bounded model step drafts variance explanations that code checks against the numbers, and a template builds the memo skeleton.

steps.short: Analyse actuals, forecasts and cash to judge Noordhaven's current and future financial position for management and board.
steps.what: Refresh driver model: volumes, shifts, flex hours, fuel, margins, cash
steps.design: Replace the FP&A Excel workbook that ties AFAS, the agency portals and Rabobank with a nightly Python job on a governed data platform. It feeds a Power BI rolling forecast and variance dashboard. A bounded model step drafts variance explanations that code checks against the numbers, and a template builds the memo skeleton.

steps.short: Watch cash position, reserves, tax and covenant deadlines daily so the company stays liquid and compliant.
steps.what: Build daily cash position and 13-week cash view
steps.design: Replace the daily Excel cash sheet with a scheduled job on the governed data platform that loads Rabobank CAMT.053 statements and AFAS open items, and feeds a Power BI cash and 13-week dashboard. Deterministic rules raise Teams alerts for reserve floors, covenant ratios and VAT and loonheffing payment dates; a bounded model step proposes matches for bank lines AFAS rules leave unmatched and drafts the weekly cash note.

steps.short: Receive, check and file personnel documents (contracts, evaluations, leave, certificates, grievances) in the AFAS dossier.
steps.what: Chase managers and employees for missing or unsigned items
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: One intake mailbox and the AFAS Pocket upload feed a document queue. AFAS Jonas, or a small extraction step on the governed data platform, reads each non-medical document into dossier fields; code checks them against AFAS and a checklist per document type, and the administrator approves or fixes from an exceptions queue. Scheduled reminders chase missing items; grievance and medical files bypass the model entirely.

steps.short: Post payroll journal, pay net wages, wage tax and pension, reconcile payroll accounts.
steps.what: Reconcile payroll clearing accounts after payment
steps.design: Payroll and ledger are both in AFAS Profit, so configure the payroll run to post its journal straight to the general ledger with site cost centres and to create the payment batches. A small deterministic check compares batch totals to payroll totals and flags new or changed employee IBANs before the finance director approves the batch in Rabobank; clearing account balances show on a Power BI page.

steps.short: Answer managers' policy questions, advise on harassment and equal treatment cases, propose policy changes.
steps.what: Draft written advice to a manager on a sensitive case
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: director's case notes and the relevant policy passages
loop.output: draft advice with steps, deadlines and cited rules
loop.check: director edits and signs; draft runs on the governed tenant, no special-category data leaves it
loop.stop: one draft, regenerate on request; fallback is the director writing it
loop.why_not_simpler: each case differs; a template covers the structure, not the reasoning

steps.design: A Teams policy desk answers routine manager questions from SharePoint policies and the two CAOs with cited articles, discloses that it is an assistant (AI Act Art. 50) and hands sensitive topics straight to the HRBP queue. Every question is logged; a monthly Power BI page shows question themes by site, which feeds policy proposals, and the director drafts sensitive advice with a bounded drafting step.

steps.short: Assign ledger account, cost centre and VAT code to transactions and summarise records for the close.
steps.what: Answer controller and site questions about how items were coded
steps.design: Set supplier default coding in AFAS for fixed suppliers and add a bounded model step that suggests coding for the rest, checked against an allowed-account table and VAT rules, with the bookkeeper confirming. Bank lines and costs are booked by AFAS bank rules, and the Excel summaries become a Power BI page per site on the nightly extract, with drill-down to the coded line and the reason.

steps.short: Chase and collect missing personnel documents and certificates from employees, managers and staffing agencies.
steps.what: Pull certificates from Studytube and agency portals into one list
reasons: hands off to Learning and Development Specialist
steps.design: Replace the Excel tracking sheet with a nightly job that compares AFAS dossiers, Studytube certificates and agency worker lists against a checklist per role and site. It sends reminders by Teams or mail and shows gaps in a Power BI dashboard. Uploads go through AFAS Pocket, a bounded classification loop files them, and the administrator handles only unmatched items and staff who must be approached in person.

steps.short: Send reminders and final notices by mail, phone debtors who stay late to get payment.
steps.what: Write and send standard reminder mails in Outlook
steps.design: Configure AFAS dunning with Noordhaven's reminder sequence and Dutch/English templates so standard reminders go out without touch; a deterministic generator on the data platform drafts final notices with BW 6:119a interest and the EUR 40 minimum, which the officer approves. Before each call the case app shows a brief built from AFAS data plus a bounded model summary of the mail thread.

steps.short: Look for ways to cut cost or raise margin, such as agency overbilling, overtime, idle hours or unprofitable customers.
steps.what: Size the saving or margin gain
steps.design: Replace the ad-hoc Excel digging with scheduled rule checks on the governed data platform: agency invoices versus approved hours and agreed rates, overtime and idle hours per site, cost per pallet and margin per customer. Results appear as a ranked opportunity list in Power BI with a weekly Teams notice; agreed savings are tracked against AFAS actuals on the same dashboard.

steps.short: Look for ways to cut cost or raise margin, such as agency overbilling, overtime, idle hours or unprofitable customers.
steps.what: Write the proposal and track whether savings are realised

loop.input: savings estimate and validation notes
loop.output: one-page proposal with options and owners
loop.check: figures matched to the estimate by script; the analyst edits and approves
loop.stop: one draft; failed figure check returns it to the analyst
loop.why_not_simpler: proposal wording depends on the case; the tracker itself is a plain Power BI page on the ledger

steps.design: Replace the ad-hoc Excel digging with scheduled rule checks on the governed data platform: agency invoices versus approved hours and agreed rates, overtime and idle hours per site, cost per pallet and margin per customer. Results appear as a ranked opportunity list in Power BI with a weekly Teams notice; agreed savings are tracked against AFAS actuals on the same dashboard.

steps.short: Assess when the company needs funding or has surplus cash, and recommend credit or deposit actions.
steps.what: Gather forecast, capex plans and seasonal flex labour costs
steps.design: Build a deterministic scenario model in Power BI or Python on top of the 13-week cash view and AFAS data, with drivers for flex labour peaks, capex and payment terms. A bounded model step extracts terms from bank offers into a comparison table and drafts the recommendation memo, which the controller rewrites and owns.

steps.short: Plan the HR year: training, certificates, works council and union agenda, HR budget with Finance.
steps.what: Build the annual HR plan and calendar
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Configure Studytube expiry alerts and a Power BI certificate page joined to AFAS rosters so forklift and VCA gaps reach shift leads before they lapse. A Python costing model on the governed data platform prices CAO demands and budget scenarios from AFAS payroll and agency hours, with a bounded extraction step reading union demand letters; the director keeps the plan, the OR consultation and the bargaining.

steps.short: Plan the HR year: training, certificates, works council and union agenda, HR budget with Finance.
steps.what: Track mandatory certificates (forklift, VCA, food safety) from Studytube exports
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Configure Studytube expiry alerts and a Power BI certificate page joined to AFAS rosters so forklift and VCA gaps reach shift leads before they lapse. A Python costing model on the governed data platform prices CAO demands and budget scenarios from AFAS payroll and agency hours, with a bounded extraction step reading union demand letters; the director keeps the plan, the OR consultation and the bargaining.

steps.short: Answer shipper mails and calls about invoices, statements, delivery proof and disputed charges.
steps.what: Reply with documents or an explanation

loop.input: Classified request, account data and attached documents
loop.output: Reply draft in the customer's language
loop.check: Standard document requests use fixed templates and send automatically; any explanation text is a draft the officer approves
loop.stop: One draft; if documents are missing, route to the officer
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanations of charges and surcharges need free wording; document requests alone do not

steps.design: Put a bounded classifier on the shared debtors mailbox that tags requests and invoice numbers, after which deterministic code pulls statements and invoice copies from AFAS and proof of delivery from SharePoint and sends standard replies from templates. Explanations get a model draft for approval, and disputes open a case in the collections app that routes to sales or operations and to a bookkeeper for credit notes.

steps.short: Explain HR policies, CAO rules, procedures and Dutch law to managers and employees.
steps.what: Fix unclear or missing policy text
steps.design: An answer desk in Teams built on the M365 tenant retrieves from one approved SharePoint library (policies, both CAOs, poortwachter procedure) and answers general questions with citations and an AI disclosure; anything personal becomes a ticket for the site HRBP. A weekly report of unanswered and escalated questions feeds policy fixes.

steps.short: Keep the chart of accounts and coding rules in AFAS, code unclear entries, and fix miscodings.
steps.what: Find miscoded entries and book reclassifications
steps.design: Configure AFAS supplier defaults as the first line of coding. A nightly Python job on the governed data platform runs outlier tests over every ledger line (account against supplier history, VAT code against country, cost centre against site). A bounded model step proposes codes for the lines the defaults miss. The accountant works one Power BI exception page and approves reclasses, which post to AFAS through the UpdateConnector.

steps.short: Key supplier and agency invoices into AFAS, match them to orders or hours, post them, and pull lists into Excel.
steps.what: Export lists to Excel for open-item analysis
steps.design: Turn on AFAS UBL intake and Scan & herken so one-to-one matches post and approve themselves; a small extraction loop handles PDFs that AFAS cannot read and fails to a queue. A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform matches the three agencies' invoices to the hours in their portals and AFAS, and a Power BI page replaces the Excel open-items exports.

steps.short: Read applications in Recruitee, check them against job requirements, and pass suitable candidates to hiring managers.
steps.what: Decide on the shortlist and write a short referral note
steps.design: A small extraction job reads new Recruitee applications and writes certificate, shift and permit fields back to the candidate profile. Deterministic rules per vacancy then mark each criterion as met, missing or unclear, and show it on the candidate card. The administrator confirms the shortlist; Recruitee automations send it to the hiring manager and send Teams reminders if there is no feedback after two days.

steps.short: Read applications in Recruitee, check them against job requirements, and pass suitable candidates to hiring managers.
steps.what: Send candidates to the hiring manager and chase feedback
steps.design: A small extraction job reads new Recruitee applications and writes certificate, shift and permit fields back to the candidate profile. Deterministic rules per vacancy then mark each criterion as met, missing or unclear, and show it on the candidate card. The administrator confirms the shortlist; Recruitee automations send it to the hiring manager and send Teams reminders if there is no feedback after two days.

steps.short: Design, build, change and document finance processes, AFAS setup, Excel tools and reports.
steps.what: Design the change in ledger, workflow or report
steps.design: Move the accountants' Excel macros and one-off tools into version-controlled Python and SQL jobs on the governed data platform, built with an AI coding assistant. Each job has a test suite that runs against the AFAS extract. Procedures are drafted from config exports into SharePoint, and every change is approved by the controller before go-live.

steps.short: Work out costs of materials, overhead and expenses from quotes and price lists, and check invoices against them.
steps.what: Calculate costs and allocate overhead to sites and cost centres
steps.design: Replace the Excel cost sheet with a small price-register app on the governed data platform, fed by a bounded extraction loop for PDF quotes and rate cards and approved by the bookkeeper. A scheduled Python job computes costs and overhead allocations per site from AFAS volumes and checks every incoming AFAS invoice line against the register, sending only deviations above tolerance to the bookkeeper; results feed a Power BI page for controller and FP&A.

steps.short: Type employee changes (address, earnings, absence, production, performance notes, exit dates and reasons) into AFAS.
steps.what: Copy production and performance figures from site Excel sheets
reasons: hands off to People Analytics and HRIS Analyst
steps.design: Employees change their own address and bank details in AFAS InSite/Pocket, managers report absence and exits in AFAS workflows with mandatory reason codes, so typing disappears. A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform loads site production figures into AFAS and runs validation rules before each payroll cut-off; breaks appear on a Power BI exception page and in a daily mail to the administrator.

steps.short: Check nightly refresh, chase late data, send reports and manage who sees which dashboard.
steps.what: Chase missing or late data with HR admin and agencies
steps.design: A scheduled job checks the extract and refresh each morning, runs data checks (missing end dates, open sick reports, unknown cost centres) and posts failures to a Teams channel and a status banner on the dashboards. Power BI subscriptions replace mailed reports, and row-level security is driven by the AFAS manager hierarchy, with a daily diff of access changes the analyst approves.

steps.short: Check and approve payment requests and invoices against policy, budget and mandates before payment runs.
steps.what: Read supporting documents of non-PO requests for policy fit
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals

loop.input: Invoice PDF, agency hours export and the policy section that applies
loop.output: Policy category, cited clause and a pass/flag with one-line reason
loop.check: Amounts and hours re-checked by code against AFAS and portal data; any flag or low confidence goes to the controller
loop.stop: One pass per document, two retries on invalid output, then route to manual review
loop.why_not_simpler: Non-PO requests and agency invoices arrive as free-text documents with varying layouts and descriptions.

steps.design: Configure the AFAS Profit invoice workflow so every request runs a deterministic rule set (budget line, contract or PO, duplicate, IBAN change against supplier master, mandate register) before it reaches anyone. Requests below threshold that pass all checks go straight to the payment batch; non-PO and agency invoices get a bounded model step that matches them to policy and portal hours, and only flags and high-value items land in the controller's queue. Payment release in Rabobank keeps dual signing.

steps.short: Prepare and check monthly figures and the annual financial statements from AFAS for management, auditor and KVK.
steps.what: Tie out balances to subledgers, bank and agency accruals
steps.design: A close pipeline on the governed data platform pulls AFAS balances nightly, runs tie-outs against subledgers, CAMT.053 bank files and agency accruals, and generates the statements and notes from a maintained ledger mapping in a fixed template. A bounded model step drafts variance commentary with a number tie-out gate; the KVK filing via SBR runs through a separate filing tool since AFAS cannot file it.

steps.short: Match staff to roles, shifts and sites: redeployment, internal moves, peak-season staffing.
steps.what: Process change in AFAS, tell payroll and agency
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: Replace the site Excel sheets with a Power Apps request form and a nightly job on the existing Power BI extract that joins AFAS contracts and absence, Studytube certificates and agency headcount into a filterable availability view with hard-rule filters (valid forklift or VCA, contract hours, CAO working-time limits). The HRBP picks matches by hand; a Power Automate flow sends approved moves to HR admin and the agency order.

steps.short: Balance payroll clearing accounts in the ledger against payments to staff, tax office and pension fund.
steps.what: Tie each balance to journal, payroll tax return, pension invoice and bank
steps.design: Extend the bank-to-payroll matching job with a ledger step: it ties each payroll clearing account (net pay, wage tax, pension, garnishments) to its source files and shows an ageing list of open items on a Power BI page. The specialist explains what remains and approves drafted correcting entries, which are posted to AFAS through its UpdateConnector.

steps.short: Run job evaluation: describe jobs, score them in the function system, set the scale, handle objections.
steps.what: Rewrite description in standard format and find comparable reference jobs

loop.input: Manager's job description and the function house reference jobs
loop.output: Description in the standard template and three nearest reference jobs with differences listed
loop.check: C&B specialist checks against interview with the manager; no score is produced
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; else manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Job descriptions are free text in varying shapes; matching on titles fails.

steps.design: Configure an AFAS workflow for evaluation requests with the description attached, and add a bounded model step that rewrites descriptions into the template and lists nearest reference jobs, without scoring. A Power BI page shows the cost and pay-gap effect of a proposed grade; the committee scores, and AFAS generates the letter after approval.

steps.short: Read journals, newsletters and legal updates to stay current in L&D.
steps.what: Track rule changes: AI Act, CAO training clauses, VCA and certificate schemes
steps.design: A weekly scheduled job pulls a fixed list of feeds and official pages (EU AI Act, wetten.overheid.nl, VCA scheme owner, Studytube release notes), a bounded model step ranks and summarises them into a digest in Outlook, and page-change watchers flag rule changes. Deep reading stays with the person.

steps.short: Work out what a new initiative will cost, such as an extra shift, a new client or peak-season flex staffing.
steps.what: Write the resource summary for the requester and the controller

loop.input: checked cost model figures and assumption list
loop.output: one-page resource summary in plain Dutch or English
loop.check: Every number in the text is matched by code to a cell in the model; any mismatch blocks the draft
loop.stop: Two redrafts at most, then fall back to a fixed template with the table only
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template cannot explain which assumptions drive the cost; a short model-written paragraph can, and the number check keeps it honest

steps.design: A scheduled Python job on a governed data store pulls AFAS GetConnector data (GL, cost centres, headcount) and the agency hours and invoices into one cost base. An Excel or Power BI template then applies defined drivers (CAO rates, shift allowances, agency rates) to the scope the analyst enters. A bounded model step drafts the summary text, and code checks every figure in it against the model.

steps.short: Answer manager questions about HR dashboards, fix access or filters, explain numbers that look wrong.
steps.what: Explain the answer to the manager
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: diagnosis and verified answer
loop.output: reply in Teams, labelled as AI
loop.check: routine answers sent from verified list; new answers held for analyst review
loop.stop: one draft; otherwise escalate
loop.why_not_simpler: replies must be written for the specific question

steps.design: A Teams answer desk, read-only on the HR semantic model, answers from a list of verified answers and the metric catalogue, under each manager's row-level security with a minimum group size, and says it is AI. It checks refresh status and access first, routes everything it cannot answer to the analyst, and logs every question to a dashboard that drives report fixes.

steps.short: Pull HR data, find causes of turnover, absence and hiring problems, recommend policy changes.
steps.what: Write recommendations and present to the management team
reasons: hands off to Finance Director, another team
steps.design: Extend the nightly AFAS extract into a governed metric layer that also loads Recruitee stages, Studytube completions and agency hours, and publish fixed Power BI pages for the North Star: hire-to-day-90 retention, time to hire, week-one onboarding and verzuim by site, shift and agency. A bounded classification step tags pseudonymised exit comments into fixed themes; the director keeps the reading of causes and the recommendation.

steps.short: Build the yearly HR personnel budget in Excel from AFAS data and CAO tables, then track it monthly.
steps.what: Apply CAO wage steps, indexation, pension, social charges and agency rates
steps.design: Replace the budget workbook with a scheduled Python job on the governed data platform that reads AFAS positions and payroll, the agency invoices and a versioned CAO rate table, and writes a cost baseline plus editable scenario parameters. A Power BI page shows scenarios side by side and the monthly actual-versus-budget variance per site and cost type, refreshed with the nightly AFAS extract.

steps.short: Build the yearly HR personnel budget in Excel from AFAS data and CAO tables, then track it monthly.
steps.what: Choose hiring, flex mix, training and wage-round assumptions per site
reasons: hands off to Finance Director, another team
steps.design: Replace the budget workbook with a scheduled Python job on the governed data platform that reads AFAS positions and payroll, the agency invoices and a versioned CAO rate table, and writes a cost baseline plus editable scenario parameters. A Power BI page shows scenarios side by side and the monthly actual-versus-budget variance per site and cost type, refreshed with the nightly AFAS extract.

steps.short: Check each supplier and agency invoice against the order, goods receipt or hours, then record it in AFAS.
steps.what: Chase mismatches with the buyer, site manager or supplier

loop.input: match exception with invoice text, order lines and receipt
loop.output: likely cause (price, quantity, missing receipt, wrong order) and a draft query to buyer or supplier
loop.check: cause must cite the differing fields; draft is never sent without the bookkeeper
loop.stop: one pass per exception; low confidence or no cited field goes to the bookkeeper unclassified
loop.why_not_simpler: causes are stated in free text on PDFs and in mails, which rules cannot read

steps.design: Switch on AFAS Profit UBL intake, Scan & herken and line-level three-way matching with set tolerances, so one-to-one matches are posted and released for approval without a touch. A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads agency portal hours, checks agency invoices, proposes the g-rekening split and posts only differences to a review queue. A small model step classifies the remaining exceptions and drafts the query for the bookkeeper to send.

steps.short: Prepare VAT returns and the corporate tax position from AFAS and file them with the tax office.
steps.what: Compute corporate tax estimate, provisions and fiscal adjustments
steps.design: Configure the AFAS VAT return and Jonas checks, and add a scheduled Python job on the data platform that reconciles VAT accounts to the return and tests every invoice line (missing or wrong VAT code, reverse charge on agency and foreign invoices, ICP totals against intra-EU sales). Exceptions land in a list for the accountant; the corporate tax estimate stays a human workpaper, and filing and payment keep the controller's approval.

steps.short: Assess credit limit requests for new and growing shippers, and prepare bank facility applications and covenant files.
steps.what: Decide limit, payment terms and any security
reasons: hands off to Credit and Collections Officer
steps.design: A request form in Teams/SharePoint starts a workflow that pulls the KvK extract, credit report and AFAS payment history into one credit file. Deterministic rules from the written credit policy compute a proposed limit. For legal entities a bounded model step extracts ratios from the filed accounts. The director approves in one screen, and the approved limit is written to the AFAS debtor record with a log entry.

steps.short: Gather hours, overtime, shift allowances and absence from sites and systems into the monthly payroll input.
steps.what: Gather hours, overtime, absence and agency hours exports
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: Replace the monthly Excel input sheet with a scheduled Python job on the governed data platform. It pulls approved hours and absence from AFAS and agency hours files from the three portals. It applies the CAO overtime and shift allowance rules from explicit, versioned tables and stages the variable pay lines. After the specialist approves the staged batch, the job posts it to AFAS through an UpdateConnector. A Power BI page shows labour cost per site, own staff versus flex, for the controller.

steps.short: Review aging and collection reports to see overdue balances, DSO and which debtors need action.
steps.what: Review top overdue debtors, DSO trend and site splits
reasons: hands off to Credit and Collections Officer
steps.design: Replace the weekly Excel aging pack with a Power BI collections page on the nightly AFAS extract, showing DSO, overdue by debtor and site, and dispute status. A bounded model step labels debtor mails in the shared collections mailbox, and the officer confirms the label before it goes into AFAS. A notification flags debtors that cross a set threshold to the director.

steps.short: Test internal controls, investigate exceptions and write findings reports for management and the auditor.
steps.what: Write the findings report with risk, cause and recommendation

loop.input: Test results, exception counts and the accountant's evidence notes per finding
loop.output: Finding text in a fixed template: condition, criterion, cause, risk, recommendation
loop.check: All counts and amounts tied to test output by code; each finding links to its evidence; no finding without a test reference
loop.stop: One draft per finding, one retry on failed check, then left for the accountant to write
loop.why_not_simpler: Cause and recommendation come from free-text notes that a template cannot write on its own

steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the data platform tests every AFAS transaction and master data change (duplicate invoices, IBAN changes before payment, users who can both create vendors and approve payments) and writes results to a control dashboard. A bounded model step drafts findings in a fixed template with tie-out checks, and a SharePoint list tracks actions with Teams reminders to owners.

steps.short: Forecast staffing needs per site and shift from volume plans, turnover and absence.
steps.what: Gather headcount, turnover, absence and flex hours per site
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform builds the workforce baseline from AFAS and the agency portals, and a small form (Microsoft Forms or a SharePoint list) collects site volume plans in a fixed format. A deterministic model with stated assumptions turns them into FTE need per site and shift under three scenarios in Power BI, feeding the budget and the recruiters' pipeline.

steps.short: Build reports and slides on employee satisfaction and related data for management and the works council.
steps.what: Write narrative and build slides for MT and OR

loop.input: satisfaction tables, comment themes and last period's report
loop.output: draft slides and a one-page summary with changes since last period
loop.check: every number traces to the Power BI table; HRBP edits conclusions and actions
loop.stop: one draft plus one revision
loop.why_not_simpler: the narrative must explain changes in words; the table layout itself is fixed and generated without a model

steps.design: A scheduled job loads survey and register data next to the nightly AFAS extract into Power BI, which produces the site and department tables with a minimum group size. A bounded model step themes anonymised comments, and a report generator fills the house PowerPoint template with tables and a draft narrative for the HRBP to edit before the MT and OR meeting.

steps.short: Find candidates for open roles through job boards, agencies, talent pool, referrals and direct outreach.
steps.what: Track sources and responses in Excel and report source of hire
steps.design: Configure Recruitee multiposting, source tags and email templates so ads and tracking stop being manual. A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads the Recruitee talent pool via API, applies hard filters in code and runs a bounded model pass that marks must-haves with quoted CV evidence; outreach drafts land in Recruitee for the recruiter to approve. A Power BI page joins Recruitee source tags with AFAS 90-day retention so channels are judged on hires who stay.

steps.short: Check transactions against evidence and rules, and ask staff about exceptions, to confirm correct booking and compliance.
steps.what: Match transactions to invoices, contracts, hours and approvals
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals

loop.input: Agency invoice PDFs and contract terms not available as structured data
loop.output: Rates, hours, VAT code, G-account share and invoice totals per line
loop.check: Extracted lines must sum to the invoice total and match portal hours and agreed rates; mismatches go to review
loop.stop: One extraction per document, one retry on a failed sum check, then manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Three agencies send different PDF layouts; until e-invoicing applies, the data is not structured

steps.design: A workflow on the governed data platform tests every agency invoice, payment and payroll journal instead of a sample: it pulls AFAS and portal data, extracts unstructured agency PDFs in a bounded step, and checks rates, hours, VAT, G-account splits and agency certificates by rule. Exceptions land in a Power BI list with a generated findings template; the accountant does the interviews and approves corrections.

steps.short: Gather actuals, prior budgets and site estimates into the budget workbook for FP&A.
steps.what: Export actuals and prior budget from AFAS and Power BI into Excel
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads the AFAS general ledger and prior budget, applies a maintained account-to-budget-line mapping and writes the budget pack to SharePoint. Site estimates come in through a Microsoft Forms or Power Apps entry screen with reminders, and a bounded model step drafts variance notes from site comments for the bookkeeper to check before FP&A gets the pack.

steps.short: Process hires, exits, leave, transfers and promotions in AFAS, with contract letters and notifications.
steps.what: Notify payroll, IT, site lead and L&D of the change
steps.design: A Recruitee-to-AFAS connector and an AFAS manager form start every personnel action as one AFAS workflow. Deterministic checks (CAO scale, ketenregeling, notice period, approvals present) run in code, the change is prepared in AFAS for one-click approval, the contract is merged from the SharePoint template, and notifications and Studytube enrolments go out automatically.

steps.short: Track training spend against budget and write reports that justify the cost to HR and finance.
steps.what: Write the budget report explaining spend and outcomes

loop.input: Variance table, certificate coverage and onboarding figures for the period
loop.output: Draft narrative of two to three paragraphs per section
loop.check: Every number in the text is matched against the source table by code; mismatches block the draft
loop.stop: Up to two redrafts; then the specialist writes the section
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template covers the tables, but the explanation of why spend moved needs written text that changes each period.

steps.design: Replace the training-cost Excel file with a nightly job on the governed data platform that pulls training-related invoices and ledger lines from AFAS and enrolments from Studytube, allocates them by rules plus a small classification loop for unclear invoice lines, and feeds a Power BI training-spend page next to the existing HR dashboards. Each quarter a generator drafts the budget report from the same tables; the specialist edits it and the controller sees the same numbers.

steps.short: Research benefit and health and safety practices and propose policy changes to HR leadership.
steps.what: Pull internal data on uptake, cost, absence and incidents
steps.design: A monthly bounded model job reads a fixed source list and writes a cited digest to SharePoint. A Power BI page on the nightly AFAS extract shows benefits uptake, cost and absence by site and group. A reusable Python or Excel costing model replaces one-off spreadsheets, and a model drafts the memo from it.

steps.short: Research benefit and health and safety practices and propose policy changes to HR leadership.
steps.what: Compare options and cost them for Noordhaven's population
reasons: hands off to FP&A Analyst, another team
steps.design: A monthly bounded model job reads a fixed source list and writes a cited digest to SharePoint. A Power BI page on the nightly AFAS extract shows benefits uptake, cost and absence by site and group. A reusable Python or Excel costing model replaces one-off spreadsheets, and a model drafts the memo from it.

steps.short: Research benefit and health and safety practices and propose policy changes to HR leadership.
steps.what: Write recommendation and present to HR Director and works council

loop.input: option costing, practice summary and the specialist's chosen option
loop.output: first draft memo in the house format
loop.check: Specialist rewrites and signs; figures pulled only from the costing file
loop.stop: One draft; no figures generated by the model
loop.why_not_simpler: The memo is prose; templates help only with structure.

steps.design: A monthly bounded model job reads a fixed source list and writes a cited digest to SharePoint. A Power BI page on the nightly AFAS extract shows benefits uptake, cost and absence by site and group. A reusable Python or Excel costing model replaces one-off spreadsheets, and a model drafts the memo from it.

steps.short: Assess when the company needs funding or has surplus cash, and recommend credit or deposit actions.
steps.what: Write recommendation memo to finance director

loop.input: Chosen scenario, comparison table and controller's notes
loop.output: Two-page memo draft
loop.check: Figures inserted by code from the model; controller rewrites reasoning and signs off
loop.stop: One draft, controller edits
loop.why_not_simpler: The memo argues a case in prose; a template covers only the figures.

steps.design: Build a deterministic scenario model in Power BI or Python on top of the 13-week cash view and AFAS data, with drivers for flex labour peaks, capex and payment terms. A bounded model step extracts terms from bank offers into a comparison table and drafts the recommendation memo, which the controller rewrites and owns.

steps.short: Reconcile bank, agency, payroll clearing and intercompany accounts and clear the differences.
steps.what: Download Rabobank statements and AFAS ledger lines into Excel
steps.design: A daily Python job on the governed data platform reads Rabobank CAMT.053, AFAS ledger lines, agency hours and the payroll journal and applies fixed match rules, leaving a short open item list in a reconciliation app. A bounded model step proposes matches for the leftovers; the accountant approves corrections, which are posted to AFAS, and the workpaper is generated for the controller.

steps.short: Answer manager and employee questions on CAO, pay, benefits, procedures and grading.
steps.what: Draft and send the answer

loop.input: question and retrieved passages
loop.output: draft answer citing CAO article or policy section
loop.check: Citation required for each rule stated; specialist approves before sending; standard questions may later go out with the AI notice after a review period
loop.stop: One draft and one retry; no citation means no draft
loop.why_not_simpler: Answers combine several rules for one person's case; fixed templates cover only common questions.

steps.design: A shared Outlook or Teams intake creates a case in a simple list, and an answer desk indexes the CAO texts, policies and templates on SharePoint to draft cited answers. The specialist approves each draft, and repeat questions feed a FAQ page that managers can read themselves. Personal data from AFAS is only looked up for the case at hand, and access is logged under GDPR.

steps.short: Work out Noordhaven's corporate tax and VAT positions, depreciation differences and the tax provision each quarter and year-end.
steps.what: Judge uncertain positions, estimate Vpb provision and deferred tax
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform pulls the AFAS trial balance, asset register and VAT ledgers through the AFAS API, computes the fiscal adjustment schedule by fixed rules, and runs one bounded classification pass over unclear cost lines. It generates the tax workpaper in a fixed template on SharePoint; the accountant judges positions and signs, and AFAS Jonas is used for its checks when filing the returns.

steps.short: Prepare and check monthly figures and the annual financial statements from AFAS for management, auditor and KVK.
steps.what: Map ledger to statement lines, build statements and notes
steps.design: A close pipeline on the governed data platform pulls AFAS balances nightly, runs tie-outs against subledgers, CAMT.053 bank files and agency accruals, and generates the statements and notes from a maintained ledger mapping in a fixed template. A bounded model step drafts variance commentary with a number tie-out gate; the KVK filing via SBR runs through a separate filing tool since AFAS cannot file it.

steps.short: Chase and collect missing personnel documents and certificates from employees, managers and staffing agencies.
steps.what: Find which dossiers miss documents or certificates
steps.design: Replace the Excel tracking sheet with a nightly job that compares AFAS dossiers, Studytube certificates and agency worker lists against a checklist per role and site. It sends reminders by Teams or mail and shows gaps in a Power BI dashboard. Uploads go through AFAS Pocket, a bounded classification loop files them, and the administrator handles only unmatched items and staff who must be approached in person.

steps.short: Design, build, change and document finance processes, AFAS setup, Excel tools and reports.
steps.what: Test the change and write procedures in SharePoint
reasons: hands off to Bookkeeper (accounts payable and receivable)

loop.input: Config export, job code and test results
loop.output: Procedure text and a test case list
loop.check: Code checks every config item and job step appears in the procedure; the accountant reads and edits
loop.stop: One draft per change; missing items listed for the accountant to write
loop.why_not_simpler: Procedures are prose for bookkeepers; a template cannot explain why a step exists

steps.design: Move the accountants' Excel macros and one-off tools into version-controlled Python and SQL jobs on the governed data platform, built with an AI coding assistant. Each job has a test suite that runs against the AFAS extract. Procedures are drafted from config exports into SharePoint, and every change is approved by the controller before go-live.

steps.short: Enter purchase orders from requests and process staff expense claims with receipts.
steps.what: Check budget and cost centre, route for approval
steps.design: Configure AFAS InSite purchase requests and expense claims so requesters enter their own orders and claims, with approval workflows by cost centre and budget limits. Receipts uploaded with a claim pass through a bounded extraction step that fills amount, VAT and a suggested account; policy rules flag exceptions for the bookkeeper and approved claims flow to payroll or the payment run.

steps.short: Run the yearly budget and steer planning and procurement across three sites and departments.
steps.what: Chase submissions and consolidate Excel files
steps.design: Replace the e-mailed Excel templates with a small budget entry app on the data platform, with automated reminders by Teams and a consolidation that is always current. A Power BI view shows variance against prior year and drivers, a bounded model step drafts questions for flagged lines, and the approved budget loads into AFAS by API.

steps.short: Plan the HR year: training, certificates, works council and union agenda, HR budget with Finance.
steps.what: Agree HR and flex worker budget with Finance
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
hands off to FP&A Analyst, another team
steps.design: Configure Studytube expiry alerts and a Power BI certificate page joined to AFAS rosters so forklift and VCA gaps reach shift leads before they lapse. A Python costing model on the governed data platform prices CAO demands and budget scenarios from AFAS payroll and agency hours, with a bounded extraction step reading union demand letters; the director keeps the plan, the OR consultation and the bargaining.

steps.short: Pull AFAS, Recruitee and Studytube data into Excel, build tables and charts, write commentary, send to managers.
steps.what: Check numbers and send to HR director, HRBPs and site managers
steps.design: Replace the Excel workbooks with a scheduled extract from AFAS GetConnectors, Recruitee and Studytube APIs into one governed Power BI semantic model with fixed metric definitions. Standard reports become Power BI paginated reports with subscriptions; a bounded model step drafts the commentary from the delta table, and the analyst approves before release. Custom requests are built on the same model, not from fresh exports.

steps.short: Match bank, ledger and agency invoice lines; chase and report what does not match.
steps.what: Ask suppliers, customers or colleagues for missing data by email

loop.input: discrepancy item with amounts, invoice numbers and supplier contact
loop.output: short Dutch or English query email draft
loop.check: amounts and numbers in the draft are compared to the source record; mismatch blocks the draft
loop.stop: one draft per item; the bookkeeper edits and sends
loop.why_not_simpler: A template covers the common cases; the loop only adds value for odd cases, so it can be dropped if templates suffice.

steps.design: Turn on and tune AFAS bank matching with tolerances, and replace the reconciliation Excel sheets with a scheduled Python job on a governed data platform that reads AFAS open items, ledger balances and the three agency portals' hours and invoices. A bounded model step proposes matches for leftover bank lines; everything that stays unmatched lands in one queue and a Power BI page the controller reads at close.

steps.short: Process joiners, transfers, leavers and tax credit choices into AFAS payroll records, including final settlements.
steps.what: For leavers: calculate leave payout, final pay and transition payment
reasons: hands off to Accountant, another team
steps.design: HR admin enters joiners, transfers and leavers once in an AFAS workflow, and payroll approves the payroll fields instead of re-keying them. A deterministic validation checks required fields. A bounded extraction step compares uploaded tax credit forms and contracts with what was entered. Leaver settlements use a fixed calculation script that payroll checks before the last run.

steps.short: Test that HR reports and metrics match what HR asked for and reconcile to AFAS.
steps.what: Reconcile Power BI figures to AFAS after each refresh
steps.design: Replace the reconciliation spreadsheets with a scheduled test suite (SQL or Python) that runs after the nightly AFAS extract and before the Power BI refresh is published. Results feed a small test dashboard and a Teams message to the analyst; failed tests get a model-drafted cause list that the analyst checks and routes to the HR administrator for AFAS fixes.

steps.short: Pull transaction data and test for weak controls, duplicates, waste, fraud and policy breaches.
steps.what: Pull payments, vendor master changes, journals and user rights from AFAS and Rabobank
steps.design: Scheduled SQL and Python tests on the data platform run weekly over every AFAS payment, vendor master change, journal and Rabobank CAMT.053 statement. The results go to a Power BI exception dashboard with Teams notifications. A bounded model loop triages exceptions against the scanned invoices and agency hours, and drafts the findings. Interviews and findings stay with the accountant and the Controller.

steps.short: Build, schedule, run and score applicant tests such as forklift practicals and reading tests; check they work.
steps.what: Check test pass rates against 90-day retention and group gaps
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Configure Recruitee self-scheduling and templates for test invites; a tablet form (Microsoft Forms or a small Power App) scores multiple-choice and practical checklists by code and writes the result into Recruitee for recruiter sign-off. A Power BI page links test results to AFAS 90-day retention; a bounded model step only drafts new question items for human review.

steps.short: Build the monthly operational and risk report pack for management from AFAS, bank and agency data.
steps.what: Pull figures from AFAS, Rabobank, agency portals into Excel
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Rabobank + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: Replace the Excel pack that ties AFAS, Rabobank CAMT.053 and agency portal data with a scheduled Python job on a governed data platform that loads, ties out and flags breaks. It fills a fixed PowerPoint and Power BI pack, and a bounded model step drafts commentary only for variances above a set threshold. The Finance Director reviews and signs.

steps.short: Write job descriptions, grade jobs and maintain salary scales.
steps.what: Score the job on evaluation factors and propose a grade

loop.input: Job description and factor definitions with reference jobs
loop.output: Score per factor with reasons and the nearest reference jobs
loop.check: Specialist compares with reference jobs; a score more than one level off a near reference is flagged
loop.stop: One pass per factor; low confidence or conflict goes to the specialist unscored
loop.why_not_simpler: Factor scoring means reading a description against definitions; rules cannot read prose.

steps.design: Build a job library on the governed platform with SharePoint templates: a bounded model step drafts the description and a per-factor score with reasons, the specialist decides, and an AFAS workflow records the approved job scheme and band. Salary scales become a versioned table fed from CAO tables, replacing the Excel copies.

steps.short: Tell managers and HR about new reports, dashboard changes and metric definitions, and answer how-to questions.
steps.what: Write release note or newsletter for managers and HR
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: change list and metric definitions
loop.output: plain-language release note per audience
loop.check: Analyst reads before sending; every metric named must exist in the definitions list
loop.stop: One draft plus one revision; if checks fail the analyst writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: A template fills facts but cannot explain a changed definition in plain words for site managers

steps.design: A script reads the Power BI semantic model and deployment history to build a change list, and a bounded loop drafts the release note the analyst approves before a scheduled Teams post. How-to questions go to Copilot in Power BI on the prepared HR model with verified answers and row-level security, labelled as AI, with misses routed to the analyst.

steps.short: Receive, check and file personnel documents (contracts, evaluations, leave, certificates, grievances) in the AFAS dossier.
steps.what: Handle grievances and medical-related leave files with restricted access
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: One intake mailbox and the AFAS Pocket upload feed a document queue. AFAS Jonas, or a small extraction step on the governed data platform, reads each non-medical document into dossier fields; code checks them against AFAS and a checklist per document type, and the administrator approves or fixes from an exceptions queue. Scheduled reminders chase missing items; grievance and medical files bypass the model entirely.

steps.short: Calculate and book month-end accruals, prepayments, deferrals and corrections in AFAS, with support for the controller.
steps.what: Write support memo and tie out entries to the ledger
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform pulls the AFAS trial balance, open purchase orders and agency hours. It applies a versioned accrual rule table and writes a balanced journal batch with a tie-out workbook. A bounded model step drafts the one-off entries and memos from contracts and mails. The controller approves the batch in a simple review screen, which then posts it to AFAS through the UpdateConnector.

steps.short: Review aging and collection reports to see overdue balances, DSO and which debtors need action.
steps.what: Export aging list from AFAS and format in Excel
steps.design: Replace the weekly Excel aging pack with a Power BI collections page on the nightly AFAS extract, showing DSO, overdue by debtor and site, and dispute status. A bounded model step labels debtor mails in the shared collections mailbox, and the officer confirms the label before it goes into AFAS. A notification flags debtors that cross a set threshold to the director.

steps.short: Keep org charts, the employee handbook, directories and evaluation forms current after changes in AFAS, the CAO or policy.
steps.what: Edit handbook and policy text after CAO or policy changes
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: new CAO text or policy decision and the affected handbook sections
