loop.output: tracked-changes redline with a list of sections touched
loop.check: the administrator and HRBP review every change; section list is compared with a keyword search across the handbook for missed hits
loop.stop: one draft per change; sections the model is unsure of are flagged, not changed
loop.why_not_simpler: CAO changes are written as legal prose; finding and rewording every affected handbook section needs reading free text.

steps.design: Org charts and directories are generated each night from the AFAS org structure, either in Power BI or through the Microsoft 365 directory, so they are no longer kept by hand. Handbook changes run as a SharePoint approval flow: a bounded model step drafts a redline from the CAO or policy change, the HRBP approves it, and publishing and the Teams notice are automatic.

steps.short: Forecast staffing needs per site and shift from volume plans, turnover and absence.
steps.what: Model demand per site and shift, attrition, retirements and absence
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform builds the workforce baseline from AFAS and the agency portals, and a small form (Microsoft Forms or a SharePoint list) collects site volume plans in a fixed format. A deterministic model with stated assumptions turns them into FTE need per site and shift under three scenarios in Power BI, feeding the budget and the recruiters' pipeline.

steps.short: Assign, chase and check the bookkeepers' filing and recording work and send record packages to auditor and tax.
steps.what: Answer bookkeepers' questions on procedure and coding
reasons: hands off to Bookkeeper (accounts payable and receivable)

loop.input: A bookkeeper question in Teams plus the SharePoint finance procedures
loop.output: A short answer quoting the procedure paragraph
loop.check: Code verifies the quoted paragraph exists in the current procedure; no quote means no answer
loop.stop: One answer per question; no matching procedure or a question about amounts goes to the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions arrive in free text and a keyword search over procedures misses most of them

steps.design: Replace the Excel close checklist and the mail chasing with a Microsoft Lists close tracker plus a nightly Python check on the AFAS extract. The check flags bookings without a document, unprocessed agency invoices and late approvals, and sends Teams reminders to the owner. A Power BI page shows close status by site. A small answer desk over the SharePoint procedures handles routine questions. Record packages for the auditor are compiled from the PBC list, and an accountant sends them.

steps.short: Answer managers' policy questions, advise on harassment and equal treatment cases, propose policy changes.
steps.what: Receive manager questions by mail, Teams and phone
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: A Teams policy desk answers routine manager questions from SharePoint policies and the two CAOs with cited articles, discloses that it is an assistant (AI Act Art. 50) and hands sensitive topics straight to the HRBP queue. Every question is logged; a monthly Power BI page shows question themes by site, which feeds policy proposals, and the director drafts sensitive advice with a bounded drafting step.

steps.short: Prepare the board pack, annual accounts, bank covenant and statutory reports, then sign off and file them.
steps.what: Build board pack, covenant calculation and accounts tables in Excel/Word
steps.design: A scheduled job reads the closed AFAS period into a reporting dataset and fills fixed templates for the board pack, the bank covenant calculation and the accounts tables, with a reconciliation check against the trial balance. A bounded model step drafts commentary whose numbers code checks. Filing to KVK goes through a separate SBR tool because AFAS cannot file for large companies, and every external submission needs the director's sign-off.

steps.short: Build the yearly HR personnel budget in Excel from AFAS data and CAO tables, then track it monthly.
steps.what: Export positions, salaries and contract hours from AFAS into the budget workbook
reasons: hands off to Compensation and Benefits Specialist
steps.design: Replace the budget workbook with a scheduled Python job on the governed data platform that reads AFAS positions and payroll, the agency invoices and a versioned CAO rate table, and writes a cost baseline plus editable scenario parameters. A Power BI page shows scenarios side by side and the monthly actual-versus-budget variance per site and cost type, refreshed with the nightly AFAS extract.

steps.short: Check nightly refresh, chase late data, send reports and manage who sees which dashboard.
steps.what: Tell users about delays and changes to reports
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: A scheduled job checks the extract and refresh each morning, runs data checks (missing end dates, open sick reports, unknown cost centres) and posts failures to a Teams channel and a status banner on the dashboards. Power BI subscriptions replace mailed reports, and row-level security is driven by the AFAS manager hierarchy, with a daily diff of access changes the analyst approves.

steps.short: Record holiday, special and sick leave, keep balances right and reconcile leave with pay.
steps.what: Answer employee and team lead questions about balances
steps.design: Move leave requests into AFAS InSite and Pocket workflows, so the team lead approves and the record posts without a mail. Leave schemes for both CAOs, including expiry and part-time accrual, are configured in AFAS. A check in the same scheduled job compares absence and leave with pay mutations and lists breaks. Employees see their own balance in AFAS Pocket.

steps.short: Review balance sheet and profit and loss accounts each month for errors and unusual movements.
steps.what: Pull balance sheet, sub-ledgers and bank statements
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the data platform reconciles every balance sheet account to AFAS sub-ledgers, Rabobank CAMT.053 statements and agency portal invoices, and a Power BI close dashboard shows breaks and movements above threshold. The accountant works only the flagged accounts and proposes adjusting entries; the controller approves them before posting in AFAS.

steps.short: Review balance sheet and profit and loss accounts each month for errors and unusual movements.
steps.what: Judge unusual items and propose adjusting entries
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the data platform reconciles every balance sheet account to AFAS sub-ledgers, Rabobank CAMT.053 statements and agency portal invoices, and a Power BI close dashboard shows breaks and movements above threshold. The accountant works only the flagged accounts and proposes adjusting entries; the controller approves them before posting in AFAS.

steps.short: Record attendance, collect evaluations and report on whether training works.
steps.what: Write quarterly report for HR director and site managers
steps.design: Studytube session check-in by QR code replaces paper lists, and the nightly AFAS extract plus a Studytube feed land in a Power BI L&D page showing week-one onboarding, first-shift certification and 90-day retention by course and site. A bounded model step clusters anonymised comments at group level only, and the quarterly report is generated from the dashboard for the specialist to edit.

steps.short: Review finance processes and controls and recommend changes to procedures, systems or budgets.
steps.what: Gather process metrics: close days, touchless invoices, DSO, audit adjustments
steps.design: A finance process dashboard in Power BI on a nightly AFAS extract shows close days, touchless AP rate, DSO and audit adjustments per site. A bounded model step maps walk-through notes and the auditor letter to the control matrix, and drafts the memo with code-filled figures. The Finance Director decides and presents.

steps.short: Track how HR's internal customers (site and team managers) use HR reports and where their hiring and flex demand is rising.
steps.what: Spot teams with rising demand, long-open vacancies or unused reports
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on Fabric pulls the Power BI activity log, Recruitee vacancies and agency flex orders nightly and joins them to AFAS org units. A Power BI demand dashboard flags thresholds (vacancy open over 30 days, flex hours up 20%) and a weekly Teams post with a checked short narrative goes to each HRBP. Report usage is shown per site or team, never per named manager.

steps.short: Read new labour law, court rulings and CAO news and judge what they mean for Noordhaven.
steps.what: Assess impact on CAO talks, policies, costs and legal risk
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: A scheduled job fetches fixed sources (rechtspraak.nl, overheid.nl, Staatscourant, FNV, CNV, employer association pages) into a SharePoint list, and a bounded model step labels relevance and writes cited summaries for a weekly digest in Teams. The director writes the impact notes; a second bounded step drafts the monthly brief from them, marked as AI-generated.

steps.short: Prepare, check and file the monthly loonaangifte to the Belastingdienst and arrange payment of loonheffingen.
steps.what: Reconcile payroll journal, tax return totals and ledger in Excel
reasons: hands off to Accountant, another team
steps.design: Configure AFAS Profit to generate and file the loonaangifte through Digipoort, with one click to approve. The Excel reconciliation is replaced by a scheduled job on the AFAS extract that ties journal, return and ledger, sends breaks to the specialist and feeds a Power BI page the Accountant also uses. The job prepares the payment batch for the bookkeeper to release in Rabobank.

steps.short: Review outlines, slides and handouts from instructors before they are used.
steps.what: Write feedback to instructor and discuss changes

loop.input: Accepted findings.
loop.output: Feedback memo to the instructor.
loop.check: Specialist edits and sends.
loop.stop: One draft.
loop.why_not_simpler: Feedback must be written in clear, polite prose.

steps.design: A SharePoint intake library with a Power Automate flow replaces the mailbox and tracker; each upload triggers a bounded model check against house style, B1 reading level and the linked procedure and syllabus, and posts a findings list to the specialist. The specialist and, for safety content, the site safety lead approve before publishing to Studytube.

steps.short: Plan training sessions around rooms, forklifts, instructors and shift rosters, then book and enrol people.
steps.what: Handle cancellations, no-shows and rebookings
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads Studytube expiry dates and enrolments, AFAS employee and site data, the shift roster and Outlook resource calendars for rooms, forklifts and instructors, and proposes a session plan per site. The L&D specialist approves or edits it in a small planning app; approved sessions are created in Studytube with Outlook invites, and team leads get a notice of who is released when. No model is needed at run time.

steps.short: Analyse cost and revenue trends and commitments in Excel to project income and expenses and advise management.
steps.what: Write advice memo and discuss it with Controller and FP&A

loop.input: projection, trend tables and last month's memo
loop.output: first draft of the movements section, each claim linked to a figure
loop.check: every number in the draft is matched against the projection table by script; unmatched numbers block the draft
loop.stop: two drafts at most; otherwise the accountant writes from the tables
loop.why_not_simpler: a template can list numbers but cannot explain which movement matters and why in prose

steps.design: A nightly job on the governed data platform reads the AFAS GL and open items through the AFAS API. It writes a Power BI trend model per site and a driver-based projection in Python. A bounded model loop pulls commitments from SharePoint contracts into a schedule the accountant confirms, and drafts the movement section of the memo, which the accountant rewrites into advice.

steps.short: Compile monthly HR statistics from AFAS: hires, transfers, appraisals and absence rates, and keep the records clean.
steps.what: Check and correct data quality in Excel, chase HR admin
steps.design: The nightly AFAS extract feeds a Power BI semantic model with fixed measures for hires, transfers, appraisal completion and verzuim percentage and frequency per site (rates and durations only, minimum group of five). Deterministic checks run after each refresh and post missing end dates or open sick reports to the HR admin queue; a paginated report subscription replaces the Excel/PowerPoint pack, with a checked draft commentary the analyst edits.

steps.short: Compile monthly HR statistics from AFAS: hires, transfers, appraisals and absence rates, and keep the records clean.
steps.what: Build the monthly report pack in Excel and PowerPoint
steps.design: The nightly AFAS extract feeds a Power BI semantic model with fixed measures for hires, transfers, appraisal completion and verzuim percentage and frequency per site (rates and durations only, minimum group of five). Deterministic checks run after each refresh and post missing end dates or open sick reports to the HR admin queue; a paginated report subscription replaces the Excel/PowerPoint pack, with a checked draft commentary the analyst edits.

steps.short: Advise the MT and Finance Director on financial goals, policies and actions using actuals, forecasts and scenarios.
steps.what: Pull actuals, forecast and KPIs from AFAS and Power BI into Excel
steps.design: Replace the monthly Excel pack with a governed Power BI model on a nightly AFAS extract plus a scenario table maintained with FP&A. A small Python job drafts variance commentary and a memo skeleton with a model, inserting figures by code and logging prompt and output in SharePoint; the controller edits and presents.

steps.short: Manage pension, absence, WIA and liability insurance premiums, track rule changes and budget benefit costs.
steps.what: Reconcile premiums to AFAS payroll deductions and ledger accounts
steps.design: A shared mailbox feeds a Python job on the governed data platform that extracts premium notes into a premium register, reconciles them nightly against AFAS payroll deductions and ledger accounts, and queues differences. A monthly model digest of UWV, Belastingdienst and pension fund changes goes to the controller and C&B, and the budget is calculated by code from the FP&A headcount plan.

steps.short: Design and run onboarding and training programmes for shift and office staff across three sites.
steps.what: Track week-one onboarding completion and chase gaps
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Replace the scheduling spreadsheet with a nightly Python job on the governed data platform that reads new hires, start dates and shift rosters from AFAS, enrols people in the right Studytube onboarding path, sends Outlook invites, and flags missed week-one modules in a Power BI tile for the HR business partner. Materials are drafted in Studytube AI Authoring and approved by L&D; the site safety lead signs any safety content.

steps.short: Collect new-hire documents and key the employee, contract and pay data into AFAS.
steps.what: Check completeness: ID, BSN, IBAN, tax credit choice, pension data
steps.design: When a candidate reaches 'hired' in Recruitee, an integration creates an AFAS onboarding workflow pre-filled with offer data. The new hire completes personal data, IBAN and payroll tax choice in an AFAS InSite form. Deterministic checks validate the BSN eleven-test, IBAN check digits, required fields and the CAO scale against the offer. The specialist approves the prepared employee and contract record before it is committed. The first pre-run is then checked against the offer amount automatically.

steps.short: Calculate amounts due, payment discounts, late interest, g-rekening splits and balances for payments and customers.
steps.what: Answer one-off balance and amount questions
reasons: hands off to Credit and Collections Officer
steps.design: Configure payment terms, discounts, dunning and interest calculation in AFAS so the payment proposal and interest invoices come out of the system, with a check that no small supplier gets terms over 30 days. Deterministic code on the agency invoice applies the agreed wage tax and VAT share to the g-rekening and adds it to the payment batch; the bookkeeper approves the batch in Rabobank after reviewing IBAN-name warnings and new payees.

steps.short: Run the yearly merit and incentive round for office staff and check proposals against budget and CAO.
steps.what: Build merit matrix and budget per department
steps.design: Replace the merit Excel workbook and mail round with a small app on the governed data platform: a nightly AFAS extract feeds a manager entry form with budget, scale ceiling and gap checks built in. The specialist sees one exception dashboard, approves, and the app writes pay mutations to AFAS through its API and generates letters from SharePoint templates.

steps.short: Run the yearly merit and incentive round for office staff and check proposals against budget and CAO.
steps.what: Check proposals against budget, CAO scale maximums and gaps; settle exceptions
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Replace the merit Excel workbook and mail round with a small app on the governed data platform: a nightly AFAS extract feeds a manager entry form with budget, scale ceiling and gap checks built in. The specialist sees one exception dashboard, approves, and the app writes pay mutations to AFAS through its API and generates letters from SharePoint templates.

steps.short: Send reminders and final notices by mail, phone debtors who stay late to get payment.
steps.what: Prepare final notice with statutory interest and EUR 40 compensation
steps.design: Configure AFAS dunning with Noordhaven's reminder sequence and Dutch/English templates so standard reminders go out without touch; a deterministic generator on the data platform drafts final notices with BW 6:119a interest and the EUR 40 minimum, which the officer approves. Before each call the case app shows a brief built from AFAS data plus a bounded model summary of the mail thread.

steps.short: Prepare and check monthly records and statements for accuracy, completeness and Dutch GAAP and policy conformance.
steps.what: Write close review memo for the controller

loop.input: Tie-out results, reviewed variance explanations, posted adjustments
loop.output: Draft close memo
loop.check: Figures are pulled from the tie-out data, not generated; accountant edits and signs
loop.stop: Single draft; accountant rewrites if wrong
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template covers figures but not the narrative the controller needs

steps.design: A nightly job on the governed data platform pulls the AFAS trial balance, subledgers, Rabobank CAMT.053 and the payroll journal and runs fixed tie-outs, shown in a Power BI close dashboard. A bounded model step drafts variance explanations and the close memo with a trace-to-transaction check; adjusting entries stay with the accountant and are approved by the controller.

steps.short: Each month, match the payroll paid from Rabobank to the AFAS payroll journal and file the period-end report.
steps.what: Investigate breaks: rejected, double or off-cycle payments

loop.input: Unmatched bank lines with their free-text remittance and return-reason fields, plus the employee's payment history
loop.output: Proposed cause per break (rejected IBAN, duplicate, manual advance, off-cycle) with the evidence lines
loop.check: Proposal must cite a bank line and an AFAS record that exist; amounts must add up to the break
loop.stop: One pass per break, max two retries; unclear breaks go to the specialist unlabelled
loop.why_not_simpler: Return reasons and remittance text are free text that rules classify only partly

steps.design: Replace the Excel reconciliation with a scheduled Python job on a governed data platform that pulls the AFAS payroll journal through its GetConnector and Rabobank CAMT.053 statements, matches by batch, employee and amount, and writes a break list to a Teams channel. A small model step proposes the cause of each break; the job builds the period-end report on SharePoint for the specialist to sign before it goes to the controller.

steps.short: Advise the Finance Director and HR on the cost of pay, benefit, tax or system choices.
steps.what: Pull payroll, headcount, flex and ledger data into Excel
steps.design: A scheduled extract on the governed data platform joins AFAS payroll, headcount and ledger data with agency hours into one cost baseline. A parameterised scenario workbook (CAO rise, pension premium, flex share) reads it, and a bounded model step drafts the memo with every figure tied back to the model.

steps.short: Tell managers and HR about new reports, dashboard changes and metric definitions, and answer how-to questions.
steps.what: Answer manager questions on how to read reports and definitions
steps.design: A script reads the Power BI semantic model and deployment history to build a change list, and a bounded loop drafts the release note the analyst approves before a scheduled Teams post. How-to questions go to Copilot in Power BI on the prepared HR model with verified answers and row-level security, labelled as AI, with misses routed to the analyst.

steps.short: Read journals, newsletters and legal updates to stay current in L&D.
steps.what: Share useful findings with the HR team
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: Specialist's reading notes.
loop.output: Short Teams post with links.
loop.check: Specialist edits and posts.
loop.stop: One draft; if poor, specialist writes it.
loop.why_not_simpler: Turning notes into readable text needs writing.

steps.design: A weekly scheduled job pulls a fixed list of feeds and official pages (EU AI Act, wetten.overheid.nl, VCA scheme owner, Studytube release notes), a bounded model step ranks and summarises them into a digest in Outlook, and page-change watchers flag rule changes. Deep reading stays with the person.

steps.short: Build and roll out training on energy, fuel, waste separation and recycling for warehouse, transport and office staff.
steps.what: Draft content: e-learning, toolbox talk cards, posters, translations

loop.input: Site procedures and training brief; target languages
loop.output: Draft module, quiz questions, toolbox card and translated versions
loop.check: Specialist edits; the site lead signs off the facts; translations checked by a native-speaking colleague or team lead
loop.stop: One draft per module plus two revision rounds; otherwise manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Turning procedures into plain short lessons in several languages is writing work no template does.

steps.design: Draft modules and toolbox cards in Studytube AI Authoring from the site procedures on SharePoint, with translated versions for non-Dutch-speaking shift and flex staff, and a SharePoint approval flow for the site lead's sign-off. Studytube audience rules fed by AFAS function and site enrol people automatically, and a Power BI page puts completion next to site waste and fuel figures at site level.

steps.short: Check aging, loan and lease schedules and supplier terms so that payments in and out are up to date.
steps.what: Update tracking sheet
steps.design: Build a Power BI page on the nightly AFAS extract with AP and AR aging, loan and lease instalments matched to bank lines, and invoices stuck in approval near the 30-day limit. A scheduled job sends a Teams message to the right owner (collections, approver or controller) for each new flag, so the tracking sheet goes away.

steps.short: Keep the library of metric definitions, report templates, DAX measures and queries current and findable.
steps.what: Write or update definition and how-to documentation
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: measure name, DAX code, table descriptions, existing definition page
loop.output: plain-language definition, calculation, source fields, known caveats
loop.check: fields named must exist in the model; analyst approves before publishing
loop.stop: one draft per changed measure; unclear measures flagged for the analyst
loop.why_not_simpler: Metadata can be listed by code, but a readable definition needs prose.

steps.design: Keep templates, queries and Power BI files in a versioned SharePoint library or Git, and run a monthly script that reads model metadata and usage to list undocumented, duplicate and unused measures. A bounded model step drafts definition pages that the analyst approves, and the same definitions feed Copilot in Power BI so colleagues get answers without asking the analyst.

steps.short: Cost CAO proposals and pay scenarios from payroll data for negotiators and Finance.
steps.what: Extract headcount, pay, hours, allowances and agency hours
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: Replace the costing workbooks with a scheduled extract of AFAS payroll and agency portal hours on the governed data platform, reconciled to the ledger, plus a scenario calculator where the specialist sets wage, allowance and pension parameters. A Power BI page shows results and a bounded model step drafts the memo around code-generated tables.

steps.short: Review aging and collection reports to see overdue balances, DSO and which debtors need action.
steps.what: Add dispute, promise-to-pay and contact status from mail and notes

loop.input: debtor emails in the shared collections mailbox linked to an AFAS debtor number
loop.output: status label (dispute, promise with date, no response, paid claim) with quoted sentence
loop.check: label must be from the fixed list and the date must parse; the Collections Officer confirms before it is stored in AFAS
loop.stop: one pass per mail; unclear mails are labelled 'needs reading'
loop.why_not_simpler: debtor replies are free text in Dutch and English

steps.design: Replace the weekly Excel aging pack with a Power BI collections page on the nightly AFAS extract, showing DSO, overdue by debtor and site, and dispute status. A bounded model step labels debtor mails in the shared collections mailbox, and the officer confirms the label before it goes into AFAS. A notification flags debtors that cross a set threshold to the director.

steps.short: Forecast staffing needs per site and shift from volume plans, turnover and absence.
steps.what: Collect volume and client forecasts from operations and site managers
reasons: hands off to People Analytics and HRIS Analyst
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform builds the workforce baseline from AFAS and the agency portals, and a small form (Microsoft Forms or a SharePoint list) collects site volume plans in a fixed format. A deterministic model with stated assumptions turns them into FTE need per site and shift under three scenarios in Power BI, feeding the budget and the recruiters' pipeline.

steps.short: Match daily Rabobank statement lines to open invoices and ledger postings in AFAS and clear differences.
steps.what: Ask collections, suppliers or customers about unknown receipts and payments
reasons: hands off to Credit and Collections Officer
steps.design: Set up the AFAS automatic CAMT.053 import and tune its matching rules and tolerances so most lines clear without touch. A scheduled job on the remaining lines runs a bounded model loop that reads descriptions and remittance mails and proposes matches that must sum exactly; the bookkeeper approves in AFAS, and a daily Teams notification lists open lines older than three days to collections.

steps.short: Review incoming job applications for hard requirements and eligibility before the recruiter decides.
steps.what: Answer recruiter and manager questions on application status
steps.design: Recruitee is configured with knockout questions per vacancy type, a structured scorecard and stage-triggered mail templates; managers see status in a Recruitee pipeline view. A small bounded step reads uploaded licences and certificates into type and expiry fields shown next to the scan. The fit judgement and every reject decision stay with a person, keeping Noordhaven outside automated candidate selection.

steps.short: Answer employee questions on leave, salary scales, benefits, eligibility and CAO rules by mail, Teams and phone.
steps.what: Handle escalated questions: disputes, exceptions, sensitive situations
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Put a Teams bot in front of the HR mailbox. It quotes personal entitlements through a deterministic AFAS lookup and answers CAO and policy questions from SharePoint content with named owners, in a bounded retrieve-and-draft loop. Anything it cannot answer becomes a ticket in the existing HR queue with the employee profile attached, and a monthly report shows content gaps.

steps.short: Analyse cost actuals per site and cost type to set next year's budget and reforecasts.
steps.what: Extract cost actuals, headcount and flex invoices
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: A scheduled job loads AFAS ledger and headcount data and agency invoices into the data platform, maps them to sites and drivers by rule, and feeds a driver-based scenario model in Power BI with CAO wage steps, flex share and diesel as inputs. No model is needed at run time; unmapped cost lines go to the FP&A Analyst as an exception list.

steps.short: Process new-hire paperwork: collect data, enter employee and contract in AFAS, issue contract, notify others.
steps.what: Notify payroll, IT, manager; enrol in Studytube mandatory courses
reasons: hands off to Learning and Development Specialist
steps.design: A hire in Recruitee triggers a scheduled integration that creates a draft employee and contract in AFAS for the administrator to approve. AFAS Pocket onboarding collects the new hire's own data and documents, with Jonas reading the documents into fields. After approval, AFAS generates the CAO contract from a template and sends it for signature, and the same job notifies payroll, IT and the manager and enrols the hire in Studytube by role.

steps.short: Search employee files in AFAS and old documents to answer requests and prepare personnel actions.
steps.what: Check chain rule and CAO limits before contract extension
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Requests come in through an AFAS workflow form instead of mail. A deterministic job pulls contract history from AFAS, computes chain-rule and CAO checks, and fills standard statements from templates. A bounded extraction loop reads only non-medical scanned documents and flags mismatches. The administrator approves anything that leaves the company.

steps.short: Reconcile bank, agency, payroll clearing and intercompany accounts and clear the differences.
steps.what: Complete and sign the reconciliation workpaper
steps.design: A daily Python job on the governed data platform reads Rabobank CAMT.053, AFAS ledger lines, agency hours and the payroll journal and applies fixed match rules, leaving a short open item list in a reconciliation app. A bounded model step proposes matches for the leftovers; the accountant approves corrections, which are posted to AFAS, and the workpaper is generated for the controller.

steps.short: Maintain budgets and prepare periodic budget-versus-actual reports per site and cost centre.
steps.what: Chase budget holders by mail and write variance explanations

loop.input: variances over threshold, top journal lines behind each, and the budget holder's reply
loop.output: one or two sentences per variance with the driver named
loop.check: script confirms every amount and line cited exists in the GL; accountant approves before publishing
loop.stop: one draft per variance; no reply from the budget holder after two reminders marks it unexplained
loop.why_not_simpler: replies from budget holders are free text and must be turned into consistent commentary

steps.design: Load the budget into AFAS budget tables and extend the existing Power BI finance model with a budget-versus-actual page per site and cost centre, refreshed nightly with an automated GL tie-out. A small workflow sends variances above threshold to budget holders by Teams. A bounded model loop turns their replies and the journal lines into draft commentary the accountant approves.

steps.short: Build the yearly HR personnel budget in Excel from AFAS data and CAO tables, then track it monthly.
steps.what: Compare monthly actuals to budget and explain variances
reasons: hands off to HR Director, another team
steps.design: Replace the budget workbook with a scheduled Python job on the governed data platform that reads AFAS positions and payroll, the agency invoices and a versioned CAO rate table, and writes a cost baseline plus editable scenario parameters. A Power BI page shows scenarios side by side and the monthly actual-versus-budget variance per site and cost type, refreshed with the nightly AFAS extract.

steps.short: Turn approved vacancy requests into ads, publish them externally and internally, and close them when filled.
steps.what: Notify employees and flex workers of internal openings
steps.design: Managers submit vacancies through a Recruitee requisition or a Microsoft Forms and Power Automate flow, which checks approval against the AFAS formation. A drafting step fills the house template from the function profile and the CAO scale table; the administrator edits and approves. Recruitee multiposting then publishes it, a small job posts it to Teams, the SharePoint vacancy page and the warehouse screens, and the ads close when the stage changes to hired.

steps.short: Test internal controls, investigate exceptions and write findings reports for management and the auditor.
steps.what: Agree actions with owners and track follow-up
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the data platform tests every AFAS transaction and master data change (duplicate invoices, IBAN changes before payment, users who can both create vendors and approve payments) and writes results to a control dashboard. A bounded model step drafts findings in a fixed template with tie-out checks, and a SharePoint list tracks actions with Teams reminders to owners.

steps.short: Read new labour law, court rulings and CAO news and judge what they mean for Noordhaven.
steps.what: Brief management team, HRBPs and works council on changes
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: Approved impact notes of the month
loop.output: Two-page brief in Dutch, one section per audience
loop.check: Director edits and approves; brief only cites approved notes
loop.stop: One draft per month; if rejected, director writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: A template cannot turn varied notes into readable prose per audience.

steps.design: A scheduled job fetches fixed sources (rechtspraak.nl, overheid.nl, Staatscourant, FNV, CNV, employer association pages) into a SharePoint list, and a bounded model step labels relevance and writes cited summaries for a weekly digest in Teams. The director writes the impact notes; a second bounded step drafts the monthly brief from them, marked as AI-generated.

steps.short: Answer requests from banks, bailiffs, UWV and lenders by looking up employee data in AFAS and filling forms.
steps.what: Check, sign and send statement to requester
steps.design: A shared HR mailbox feeds a small intake workflow (Power Automate or a scheduled Python job on the governed platform). A bounded model step classifies each request and maps the form, a deterministic AFAS lookup fills the statement, and the administrator approves and sends from a review queue. Each disclosure is logged back into the AFAS dossier, and loonbeslag requests are also routed to Payroll.

steps.short: Match bank, ledger and agency invoice lines; chase and report what does not match.
steps.what: Summarise open discrepancies for the controller at month close
steps.design: Turn on and tune AFAS bank matching with tolerances, and replace the reconciliation Excel sheets with a scheduled Python job on a governed data platform that reads AFAS open items, ledger balances and the three agency portals' hours and invoices. A bounded model step proposes matches for leftover bank lines; everything that stays unmatched lands in one queue and a Power BI page the controller reads at close.

steps.short: Pull transaction data and test for weak controls, duplicates, waste, fraud and policy breaches.
steps.what: Check each exception against invoices, agency hours and approvals
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals

loop.input: one exception with its linked invoice scan, approval trail and agency hours record
loop.output: label (explained, needs follow-up, suspicious) with the document lines that support it
loop.check: label 'explained' is only accepted when the cited document line matches amount and party by script; anything else goes to the accountant
loop.stop: one pass per exception, no retries; low confidence goes straight to the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: supporting evidence is in scanned invoices and free-text approvals that rules cannot read

steps.design: Scheduled SQL and Python tests on the data platform run weekly over every AFAS payment, vendor master change, journal and Rabobank CAMT.053 statement. The results go to a Power BI exception dashboard with Teams notifications. A bounded model loop triages exceptions against the scanned invoices and agency hours, and drafts the findings. Interviews and findings stay with the accountant and the Controller.

steps.short: Follow labour-market, CAO and regional trends around Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo and write what they mean for HR strategy.
steps.what: Compare with own time to hire, wages and turnover per site
steps.design: A weekly Python job on the data platform fetches CBS StatLine and UWV open data for the three regions, and a bounded model step summarises new CAO texts and sector publications with links. A Power BI page sets these next to Noordhaven's own time to hire, offer acceptance and turnover per site, and a draft note with checked figures goes to the analyst for edit before the HR Director's meeting.

steps.short: Follow labour-market, CAO and regional trends around Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo and write what they mean for HR strategy.
steps.what: Write a short strategy note with implications

loop.input: trend comparison and the week's source summaries
loop.output: one-page note with sources and stated caveats
loop.check: code verifies every figure against the tables and every claim has a source link; no causal claims without a source
loop.stop: two drafts, then the analyst writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: the note must link outside figures to Noordhaven's sites in prose

steps.design: A weekly Python job on the data platform fetches CBS StatLine and UWV open data for the three regions, and a bounded model step summarises new CAO texts and sector publications with links. A Power BI page sets these next to Noordhaven's own time to hire, offer acceptance and turnover per site, and a draft note with checked figures goes to the analyst for edit before the HR Director's meeting.

steps.short: Check books and AFAS processes for control weaknesses, policy breaches and wasted effort; propose fixes.
steps.what: Measure process efficiency: touches, rework, close timeline
steps.design: Scheduled control tests on the governed data platform run over every AFAS journal, user right and vendor change and feed a Power BI controls and process dashboard. A bounded model step flags manual journals that may breach the SharePoint accounting policy and drafts findings; the accountant confirms and discusses fixes with the controller.

steps.short: Analyse the regional labour market and competing employers' pay and offers for drivers and warehouse staff.
steps.what: Write interpretation and advice for HR director and C&B

loop.input: dashboard figures for the quarter and last quarter's brief
loop.output: draft brief with figures, changes and caveats
loop.check: every number in the draft must match a dashboard value; claims about cause must be marked as hypotheses
loop.stop: one draft, one revision; the analyst writes the advice section
loop.why_not_simpler: The summary needs prose; the advice stays with the analyst.

steps.design: A quarterly Python job collects public labour market statistics and approved vacancy sources, a bounded extraction step turns vacancy texts into a pay benchmark table, and a Power BI page sets it against Noordhaven's CAO pay, offer acceptance and time to hire per site. A model drafts the quarterly brief from the dashboard; the analyst writes the advice.

steps.short: Build AP, AR, cash and P&L tables and reports from AFAS exports in Excel.
steps.what: Write comments on large items and movements

loop.input: Period-on-period variance table with top movements and their underlying invoices
loop.output: Short draft comment per material movement
loop.check: Every number in the draft is matched against the table by code; comments citing numbers not in the table are rejected
loop.stop: One draft per report; a failed check drops that comment and flags it for manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Explaining why a movement happened needs reading invoice descriptions and supplier names; templates give only empty phrases.

steps.design: Move the recurring AP, AR and cash tables into Power BI on the nightly AFAS extract, with subscriptions instead of mailed Excel files. A scheduled job ties report totals to the trial balance and blocks publication on a mismatch, and a bounded loop drafts comments on top movements for the bookkeeper to edit.

steps.short: Build AP, AR, cash and P&L tables and reports from AFAS exports in Excel.
steps.what: Mail reports to controller, finance director and site managers
steps.design: Move the recurring AP, AR and cash tables into Power BI on the nightly AFAS extract, with subscriptions instead of mailed Excel files. A scheduled job ties report totals to the trial balance and blocks publication on a mismatch, and a bounded loop drafts comments on top movements for the bookkeeper to edit.

steps.short: Cost CAO proposals and pay scenarios from payroll data for negotiators and Finance.
steps.what: Clean and reconcile the data with the general ledger
reasons: hands off to Controller, another team
steps.design: Replace the costing workbooks with a scheduled extract of AFAS payroll and agency portal hours on the governed data platform, reconciled to the ledger, plus a scenario calculator where the specialist sets wage, allowance and pension parameters. A Power BI page shows results and a bounded model step drafts the memo around code-generated tables.

steps.short: Coordinate the year-end audit and internal checks so accounts meet Dutch law and tax rules.
steps.what: Collect evidence: ledger exports, invoices, contracts, bank statements
steps.design: A scheduled job builds the auditor's request list into an evidence pack from AFAS, SharePoint and Rabobank statements and runs fixed control tests all year (duplicate payments, IBAN changes, approvals over limit, segregation of duties) into a Power BI exception view. A bounded model step drafts responses to auditor queries with file references; the controller decides on adjustments and signs off responses.

steps.short: Assign, chase and check the bookkeepers' filing and recording work and send record packages to auditor and tax.
steps.what: Compile and send record packages to auditor and tax adviser
steps.design: Replace the Excel close checklist and the mail chasing with a Microsoft Lists close tracker plus a nightly Python check on the AFAS extract. The check flags bookings without a document, unprocessed agency invoices and late approvals, and sends Teams reminders to the owner. A Power BI page shows close status by site. A small answer desk over the SharePoint procedures handles routine questions. Record packages for the auditor are compiled from the PBC list, and an accountant sends them.

steps.short: Review AFAS, bank and agency-portal processes and recommend controls that keep financial data reliable.
steps.what: Write findings and control recommendations

loop.input: Exception list with counts and amounts, walkthrough notes, control catalogue
loop.output: Draft finding per exception: risk, cause, recommended control, owner
loop.check: Every figure in the draft is linked to the exception table; the accountant edits and approves each finding
loop.stop: One draft per finding, at most one redraft on request; otherwise the accountant writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: Turning notes and numbers into readable findings is writing; a template fills the numbers but not the cause and advice

steps.design: Nightly deterministic tests on the governed data platform run over every AFAS mutation, payment batch, CAMT.053 statement and agency invoice (segregation of duties, IBAN changes, duplicates, unmatched agency hours) and feed a Power BI exception dashboard. Findings are drafted by a bounded model step and tracked in a SharePoint list; walkthroughs and the advice stay with the accountant.

steps.short: Analyse past and forecast results per site and customer to find cost savings and improvement areas.
steps.what: Export ledger, cost-centre and agency cost data into Excel
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: Replace the monthly Excel build with a scheduled Python job on a governed data platform that joins the AFAS ledger with agency hours and invoices and feeds a Power BI margin and unit-cost dashboard per site and customer. A bounded model step drafts flux commentary for variances above materiality, with a code check that amounts tie, and the controller edits before anything reaches the finance director.

steps.short: Advise HRBPs and managers on employee complaints about job grade or salary.
steps.what: Write advice to HRBP or manager
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: Case file and the specialist's grading view with reasons
loop.output: Advice memo in the standard template
loop.check: Every figure in the memo is pulled from the case file, not generated; specialist edits and signs
loop.stop: One draft; if the view is missing reasons, no draft is made
loop.why_not_simpler: Advice must explain reasoning in plain Dutch for a specific case; a fixed template alone reads poorly.

steps.design: Log complaints in a simple case register (SharePoint list or AFAS workflow) and auto-build a case file from AFAS and the job library, with a bounded model step that reads the complaint and one that drafts the advice memo. The judgement and the talk with the employee stay with the specialist; the same register later handles pay transparency information requests with their two-month deadline.

steps.short: Compile monthly and ad hoc personnel reports from AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and agency exports in Excel.
steps.what: Check and send report to HR director, managers and OR
steps.design: Replace the monthly Excel workbook that combines AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and agency exports with scheduled extract jobs into the governed data platform behind the existing Power BI model. Standard reports become Power BI pages with row-level security per site, and a bounded model step drafts commentary that the administrator checks before a subscription sends the report.

steps.short: Prepare and check monthly figures and the annual financial statements from AFAS for management, auditor and KVK.
steps.what: Write analytical review and variance commentary

loop.input: Variances above threshold with drill-down to journals and vendors
loop.output: Draft explanation per variance citing the journals behind it
loop.check: Every number in the text is matched against the variance table by code; unmatched numbers block the draft
loop.stop: One draft per variance; if drill-down does not explain it, mark 'needs explanation' for the accountant
loop.why_not_simpler: Explaining a variance means reading journal descriptions and writing prose; thresholds alone only flag it

steps.design: A close pipeline on the governed data platform pulls AFAS balances nightly, runs tie-outs against subledgers, CAMT.053 bank files and agency accruals, and generates the statements and notes from a maintained ledger mapping in a fixed template. A bounded model step drafts variance commentary with a number tie-out gate; the KVK filing via SBR runs through a separate filing tool since AFAS cannot file it.

steps.short: Prepare and check monthly figures and the annual financial statements from AFAS for management, auditor and KVK.
steps.what: Answer auditor questions and book audit adjustments
steps.design: A close pipeline on the governed data platform pulls AFAS balances nightly, runs tie-outs against subledgers, CAMT.053 bank files and agency accruals, and generates the statements and notes from a maintained ledger mapping in a fixed template. A bounded model step drafts variance commentary with a number tie-out gate; the KVK filing via SBR runs through a separate filing tool since AFAS cannot file it.

steps.short: Change the AFAS extract, Power BI model and dashboards when definitions, sites or CAO rules change.
steps.what: Update metric definitions and documentation
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: measure code and change spec
loop.output: plain-language definition and change note
loop.check: analyst approves; definition stored next to the measure
loop.stop: one draft per measure
loop.why_not_simpler: definitions must be readable prose for managers, generated from code

steps.design: Put the AFAS extract, Power Query and the semantic model in version control with a test set of signed-off monthly numbers; changes are drafted with a coding assistant and Copilot DAX help, tested automatically, then deployed through Power BI deployment pipelines. The definitions catalogue is generated from the model and published on SharePoint.

steps.short: Pull HR data from AFAS and agency portals and prepare required reports and filings.
steps.what: Clean data and add flex workers from agency portals
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform pulls the AFAS extract and agency hours, runs fixed data-quality checks, and fills a template per required report (works-council social data, statistics surveys, annual-report staff figures, later pay-gap reporting). A bounded model step drafts the explanation; the analyst reviews, and the HR director or controller approves before anything leaves the company.

steps.short: Analyse cost actuals per site and cost type to set next year's budget and reforecasts.
steps.what: Map costs to sites, cost centres and drivers
steps.design: A scheduled job loads AFAS ledger and headcount data and agency invoices into the data platform, maps them to sites and drivers by rule, and feeds a driver-based scenario model in Power BI with CAO wage steps, flex share and diesel as inputs. No model is needed at run time; unmapped cost lines go to the FP&A Analyst as an exception list.

steps.short: Run job evaluation: describe jobs, score them in the function system, set the scale, handle objections.
steps.what: Collect evaluation request and current job description from manager
reasons: hands off to Compensation and Benefits Specialist
steps.design: Configure an AFAS workflow for evaluation requests with the description attached, and add a bounded model step that rewrites descriptions into the template and lists nearest reference jobs, without scoring. A Power BI page shows the cost and pay-gap effect of a proposed grade; the committee scores, and AFAS generates the letter after approval.

steps.short: Keep debtor records current: address and contact changes, mergers, closures and bankruptcies.
steps.what: Handle closure or bankruptcy: block credit, claim with the curator
steps.design: A mailbox classifier and a KvK lookup feed a change queue; verified address and contact changes are written to AFAS after one-click approval, and IBAN or name changes need a second person. A nightly KvK and insolvency-register check on all active debtors raises bankruptcy alerts so credit is blocked early.

steps.short: Combine HR metrics and outside trends into a short analysis with recommendations for HR leadership.
steps.what: Decide what it means and draft recommendations
steps.design: Fixed variance rules on the Power BI HR model flag changes by site and month in 90-day retention, time to hire and verzuim rate against prior periods and the benchmark table. A bounded loop drafts a cited one-page brief that a script checks number by number; the analyst writes the recommendation and presents it.

steps.short: Advise management on recruiting and retention programmes using hiring and turnover data.
steps.what: Track programme effect in the following months
steps.design: Extend the nightly Power BI model with Recruitee pipeline data so the North Star (filled roles still productive at day 90) and its inputs show per site and job family; a bounded model step tags pseudonymised exit and onboarding comments into fixed themes. A Word template plus one draft step produces the advice note, which the HRBP rewrites and presents.

steps.short: Watch cash position, reserves, tax and covenant deadlines daily so the company stays liquid and compliant.
steps.what: Write weekly cash note and escalate risks to finance director

loop.input: Cash dashboard figures and open alerts
loop.output: Half-page cash note
loop.check: Every figure in the note is pulled from the dashboard by code, the model writes only prose around it
loop.stop: One draft per week, controller edits and sends
loop.why_not_simpler: The commentary needs plain-language explanation of movements; a template alone reads poorly.

steps.design: Replace the daily Excel cash sheet with a scheduled job on the governed data platform that loads Rabobank CAMT.053 statements and AFAS open items, and feeds a Power BI cash and 13-week dashboard. Deterministic rules raise Teams alerts for reserve floors, covenant ratios and VAT and loonheffing payment dates; a bounded model step proposes matches for bank lines AFAS rules leave unmatched and drafts the weekly cash note.

steps.short: Analyse actuals, forecasts and cash to judge Noordhaven's current and future financial position for management and board.
steps.what: Write financial position memo for management team and board
steps.design: Replace the FP&A Excel workbook that ties AFAS, the agency portals and Rabobank with a nightly Python job on a governed data platform. It feeds a Power BI rolling forecast and variance dashboard. A bounded model step drafts variance explanations that code checks against the numbers, and a template builds the memo skeleton.

steps.short: Assess credit limit requests for new and growing shippers, and prepare bank facility applications and covenant files.
steps.what: Receive credit limit request from sales or collections by mail
steps.design: A request form in Teams/SharePoint starts a workflow that pulls the KvK extract, credit report and AFAS payment history into one credit file. Deterministic rules from the written credit policy compute a proposed limit. For legal entities a bounded model step extracts ratios from the filed accounts. The director approves in one screen, and the approved limit is written to the AFAS debtor record with a log entry.

steps.short: Post payroll journal, pay net wages, wage tax and pension, reconcile payroll accounts.
steps.what: Resolve differences with the payroll specialist
reasons: hands off to Payroll Specialist, another team
steps.design: Payroll and ledger are both in AFAS Profit, so configure the payroll run to post its journal straight to the general ledger with site cost centres and to create the payment batches. A small deterministic check compares batch totals to payroll totals and flags new or changed employee IBANs before the finance director approves the batch in Rabobank; clearing account balances show on a Power BI page.

steps.short: Test that HR reports and metrics match what HR asked for and reconcile to AFAS.
steps.what: Investigate failed tests and explain the difference

loop.input: failed test, the differing employee rows (pseudonymised ids), AFAS change log for those rows
loop.output: draft cause per break (late mutation, missing end date, definition gap) with row references
loop.check: every cited row must exist in the diff; cause must be one of a fixed list or 'unknown'
loop.stop: one pass per break, max 50 breaks per run; above that or on check failure, send the raw diff to the analyst
loop.why_not_simpler: Rule checks catch known causes; the remaining breaks need reading of free-text mutation notes and context.

steps.design: Replace the reconciliation spreadsheets with a scheduled test suite (SQL or Python) that runs after the nightly AFAS extract and before the Power BI refresh is published. Results feed a small test dashboard and a Teams message to the analyst; failed tests get a model-drafted cause list that the analyst checks and routes to the HR administrator for AFAS fixes.

steps.short: Calculate customer charges for storage and transport, issue invoices and send account statements.
steps.what: Handle billing questions and issue credit notes
steps.design: Move the contract rates from Excel into AFAS (or a rate table on the data platform) and let a scheduled job read operations exports, price them and create invoice proposals in AFAS. The bookkeeper approves the batch only where it deviates from last month by more than a set margin; AFAS sends invoices and monthly statements on its own schedule.

steps.short: Advise the MT and Finance Director on financial goals, policies and actions using actuals, forecasts and scenarios.
steps.what: Write the advice memo or MT deck with options and a recommendation

loop.input: variance analysis, scenario table and the question from the MT
loop.output: memo skeleton with figures, options and risks
loop.check: figures inserted by code from the dataset, not by the model; controller writes or edits the recommendation
loop.stop: one draft per request; if sources are missing the draft lists the gap instead of filling it
loop.why_not_simpler: the narrative changes per question; a fixed template covers the tables but not the argument

steps.design: Replace the monthly Excel pack with a governed Power BI model on a nightly AFAS extract plus a scenario table maintained with FP&A. A small Python job drafts variance commentary and a memo skeleton with a model, inserting figures by code and logging prompt and output in SharePoint; the controller edits and presents.

steps.short: Design and revise pay, promotion and appraisal methods, test their effects, and explain them to managers and staff.
steps.what: Pull salary, grade, promotion, offer and training data into Excel
steps.design: A nightly job on a governed data platform joins the AFAS extract already used for Power BI with Recruitee offers and Studytube completions, and feeds a Power BI page showing raises, promotions and offer acceptance per grade, site and gender. A bounded drafting step turns the specialist's chosen options and the CAO text into policy and guide drafts in Word on SharePoint; consultation and consent stay with people.

steps.short: Design and revise pay, promotion and appraisal methods, test their effects, and explain them to managers and staff.
steps.what: Analyse how current methods work: offer acceptance, promotion rates, raises by group
steps.design: A nightly job on a governed data platform joins the AFAS extract already used for Power BI with Recruitee offers and Studytube completions, and feeds a Power BI page showing raises, promotions and offer acceptance per grade, site and gender. A bounded drafting step turns the specialist's chosen options and the CAO text into policy and guide drafts in Word on SharePoint; consultation and consent stay with people.

steps.short: Forecast staffing needs per site and shift from volume plans, turnover and absence.
steps.what: Choose scenarios: hire, flex, overtime or training per site
reasons: hands off to Finance Director, another team
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform builds the workforce baseline from AFAS and the agency portals, and a small form (Microsoft Forms or a SharePoint list) collects site volume plans in a fixed format. A deterministic model with stated assumptions turns them into FTE need per site and shift under three scenarios in Power BI, feeding the budget and the recruiters' pipeline.

steps.short: Check transactions against evidence and rules, and ask staff about exceptions, to confirm correct booking and compliance.
steps.what: Document findings, corrections and follow-up actions
steps.design: A workflow on the governed data platform tests every agency invoice, payment and payroll journal instead of a sample: it pulls AFAS and portal data, extracts unstructured agency PDFs in a bounded step, and checks rates, hours, VAT, G-account splits and agency certificates by rule. Exceptions land in a Power BI list with a generated findings template; the accountant does the interviews and approves corrections.

steps.short: Manage pension, absence, WIA and liability insurance premiums, track rule changes and budget benefit costs.
steps.what: Build benefit and insurance budget from headcount and wage plan
steps.design: A shared mailbox feeds a Python job on the governed data platform that extracts premium notes into a premium register, reconciles them nightly against AFAS payroll deductions and ledger accounts, and queues differences. A monthly model digest of UWV, Belastingdienst and pension fund changes goes to the controller and C&B, and the budget is calculated by code from the FP&A headcount plan.

steps.short: Gather actuals, prior budgets and site estimates into the budget workbook for FP&A.
steps.what: Check totals and explain big differences against last year

loop.input: budget lines whose change versus prior year passes a set threshold, with the site estimate comments
loop.output: one-line draft explanation per flagged line, marked 'from site comment' or 'unknown'
loop.check: totals and thresholds are computed in code; the model only words reasons found in the site comments, and every note is shown next to its numbers for the bookkeeper
loop.stop: one pass per flagged line, at most 50 lines; if no site comment exists the line is marked 'ask site' and goes to the person
loop.why_not_simpler: the reasons sit in free-text mail and comments from site managers; a rule cannot turn them into a short note

steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads the AFAS general ledger and prior budget, applies a maintained account-to-budget-line mapping and writes the budget pack to SharePoint. Site estimates come in through a Microsoft Forms or Power Apps entry screen with reminders, and a bounded model step drafts variance notes from site comments for the bookkeeper to check before FP&A gets the pack.

steps.short: Run the yearly appraisal and merit cycle and check ratings and raises for unequal treatment.
steps.what: Set up appraisal cycle, send forms to managers, chase late ones
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Move the appraisal and merit round from mailed Excel files into AFAS Profit workflows and forms, with reminders handled by the workflow. A deterministic job on the AFAS extract computes rating and raise distributions per group and flags outliers in Power BI before calibration, and fills a fixed report template for the HR director and works council. No model is needed at run time.

steps.short: Track how HR's internal customers (site and team managers) use HR reports and where their hiring and flex demand is rising.
steps.what: Mail HRBPs and recruiters a short summary per site
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

loop.input: demand signals table for one site, with last month's values
loop.output: five-line plain summary per site in a Teams post
loop.check: every number in the text is matched against the table by code; mismatch blocks the post
loop.stop: two attempts, then the table is sent without text
loop.why_not_simpler: a fixed template cannot say which of several moving signals matters most this week

steps.design: A scheduled Python job on Fabric pulls the Power BI activity log, Recruitee vacancies and agency flex orders nightly and joins them to AFAS org units. A Power BI demand dashboard flags thresholds (vacancy open over 30 days, flex hours up 20%) and a weekly Teams post with a checked short narrative goes to each HRBP. Report usage is shown per site or team, never per named manager.

steps.short: Prepare monthly and annual statements, management reports, forecasts, budgets and filings like VAT, CBS and KVK.
steps.what: Draft statements, management report and flux commentary

loop.input: statements built by code plus variance table
loop.output: flux commentary and report text
loop.check: numbers in text compared by code with the statements; draft blocked unless tie-out report is green
loop.stop: one draft and one retry per section, then blank for the controller
loop.why_not_simpler: tables come from code; explaining movements needs free text

steps.design: Move the close workbook to scheduled SQL/Python on a governed data platform fed by the AFAS extract and Rabobank CAMT.053 files: it builds statements, runs the tie-outs and publishes a Power BI close page. A bounded model step drafts commentary only after the tie-out is green; VAT stays in AFAS and the KVK SBR filing runs through filing software or the auditor, since AFAS cannot file it for large companies.

steps.short: Keep job, pay and benefit records in AFAS right, and update the staff handbook and regulations.
steps.what: Update handbook and benefit regulations after CAO or policy changes

loop.input: New CAO or policy text and the current handbook sections
loop.output: Redline of affected sections with source references
loop.check: Specialist approves each change; deterministic check that every amount and date in the redline appears in the source
loop.stop: One pass per changed source document; unmatched sections go to the specialist
loop.why_not_simpler: Finding which handbook passages a CAO change touches requires reading free text

steps.design: Change requests come in through AFAS Profit workflow forms with field validation, so the specialist approves rather than types. A nightly deterministic check on the AFAS extract compares grades and scales with the CAO scale table and the job schemes AFAS Profit 8 stores, and sends an exception list to HR admin. A bounded drafting step turns CAO or policy changes into a handbook redline on SharePoint, with versioned publishing and a change notice.

steps.short: Evaluate a new or changed job, decide its grade, CAO status and salary band.
steps.what: Write the grading rationale and inform manager and HRBP
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: A Microsoft Forms or Power Apps intake feeds a bounded model step that drafts the job description and per-factor scores with reasons against Noordhaven's evaluation system and reference jobs. The specialist decides the grade in AFAS Profit job schemes, and every proposal, score and decision is logged for the pay transparency report and AI Act oversight. CAO-covered jobs stay inside the CAO grading system and are only checked, never rescored.

steps.short: Write and maintain internal control policies for budgets, cash, credit and accounting.
steps.what: Draft policy and procedure text

loop.input: Gap list, current handbook, house template
loop.output: Redline of the affected handbook sections
loop.check: Controller reviews redline; code checks that limits and roles match the authorisation matrix
loop.stop: One draft per gap; controller rewrites if off target
loop.why_not_simpler: Policy text must be written and fitted into existing wording; a template only gives structure.

steps.design: Keep the finance handbook as one versioned SharePoint library tied to the AFAS authorisation matrix and a mandate register. Audit and control-test exceptions feed a gap list; a bounded model step drafts redlines, code checks limits against the matrix, and approved changes are configured as AFAS approval workflows and pushed to budget holders as a short Studytube module.

steps.short: Call and mail overdue shippers, explain the claim, and agree payment, a plan or a return.
steps.what: Confirm agreement or payment plan by mail and set reminder
steps.design: A collections workbench on the governed data platform reads AFAS ageing nightly, ranks accounts and assembles a dispute file per debtor with a bounded model summary of Outlook threads. The officer calls with the file open, confirms model-extracted outcome fields that write back to AFAS, and sends template confirmations; Finance Director approves plans above a set amount.

steps.short: Answer site managers and budget holders on accounting, budget and spending rules, and steer cost control.
steps.what: Write the answer or guidance note with the rule and the numbers

loop.input: Question text, retrieved handbook sections, cost-centre budget figures
loop.output: Draft answer citing handbook section and figures, or 'escalate'
loop.check: Every claim must cite a handbook section id; figures are inserted by code, not by the model; controller approves first-of-kind answers
loop.stop: One draft per question, one retry if citation check fails, else route to controller unanswered
loop.why_not_simpler: Questions arrive as free text in varied wording; a fixed FAQ menu does not match them reliably.

steps.design: A Teams intake form replaces loose mails and tags each question with cost centre and topic. A small answer desk on the Microsoft 365 tenant retrieves the finance handbook from SharePoint and pulls budget-vs-actual from the nightly AFAS extract, drafts a cited answer, and the controller approves new kinds of answers; approved ones feed a FAQ.

steps.short: Analyse the regional labour market and competing employers' pay and offers for drivers and warehouse staff.
steps.what: Compare with own pay, offer acceptance and time to hire
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Recruitee + Power BI
hands off to Compensation and Benefits Specialist
steps.design: A quarterly Python job collects public labour market statistics and approved vacancy sources, a bounded extraction step turns vacancy texts into a pay benchmark table, and a Power BI page sets it against Noordhaven's CAO pay, offer acceptance and time to hire per site. A model drafts the quarterly brief from the dashboard; the analyst writes the advice.

steps.short: Cost CAO proposals and pay scenarios from payroll data for negotiators and Finance.
steps.what: Write findings for HR and Finance Directors and negotiators

loop.input: Scenario tables and the specialist's key points
loop.output: Memo and slides with tables generated from the model
loop.check: All numbers come from the scenario tables by code; specialist reviews wording
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; then manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables can be generated by code, but the short narrative for directors needs writing.

steps.design: Replace the costing workbooks with a scheduled extract of AFAS payroll and agency portal hours on the governed data platform, reconciled to the ledger, plus a scenario calculator where the specialist sets wage, allowance and pension parameters. A Power BI page shows results and a bounded model step drafts the memo around code-generated tables.

steps.short: Compile monthly HR statistics from AFAS: hires, transfers, appraisals and absence rates, and keep the records clean.
steps.what: Write commentary and send to HR Director and site management

loop.input: month's HR statistics per site with prior month and same month last year
loop.output: half-page commentary on movements over a set threshold
loop.check: code checks every figure and site name against the statistics table; no individual names or absence causes allowed
loop.stop: two drafts, then the analyst writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: choosing which of many movements to explain and phrasing it plainly varies each month

steps.design: The nightly AFAS extract feeds a Power BI semantic model with fixed measures for hires, transfers, appraisal completion and verzuim percentage and frequency per site (rates and durations only, minimum group of five). Deterministic checks run after each refresh and post missing end dates or open sick reports to the HR admin queue; a paginated report subscription replaces the Excel/PowerPoint pack, with a checked draft commentary the analyst edits.

steps.short: Enter purchase orders from requests and process staff expense claims with receipts.
steps.what: Check claims against expense policy and approve exceptions
reasons: hands off to Payroll Specialist, another team
steps.design: Configure AFAS InSite purchase requests and expense claims so requesters enter their own orders and claims, with approval workflows by cost centre and budget limits. Receipts uploaded with a claim pass through a bounded extraction step that fills amount, VAT and a suggested account; policy rules flag exceptions for the bookkeeper and approved claims flow to payroll or the payment run.

steps.short: Work out costs of materials, overhead and expenses from quotes and price lists, and check invoices against them.
steps.what: Send the cost overview to controller and FP&A
steps.design: Replace the Excel cost sheet with a small price-register app on the governed data platform, fed by a bounded extraction loop for PDF quotes and rate cards and approved by the bookkeeper. A scheduled Python job computes costs and overhead allocations per site from AFAS volumes and checks every incoming AFAS invoice line against the register, sending only deviations above tolerance to the bookkeeper; results feed a Power BI page for controller and FP&A.

steps.short: Model tax scenarios on planned investments and results, and agree tax choices with the advisor and finance director.
steps.what: Model scenarios: investment deductions, provisions timing, loss carry-forward, fiscal unity
steps.design: A scenario model in Python on the governed data platform reads the FP&A forecast, capex plan and AFAS actuals, and computes tax outcomes per scenario from versioned rule parameters (rates, deduction brackets). A bounded model step digests rule changes and drafts the decision memo; the controller and advisor make the choices.

steps.short: Prepare and file VAT and ICP returns, statistics and agency liability papers to Belastingdienst and others.
steps.what: Collect agency payment-behaviour statements and check g-rekening payments
steps.design: Use the VAT and ICP reporting and digital submission already in AFAS, and add a scheduled rule job that flags suspicious VAT lines, with a bounded model step that proposes a code from the invoice text for the bookkeeper to accept. A small tracker on SharePoint or the data platform requests and records agency payment-behaviour statements and checks each agency payment batch for the g-rekening split, alerting the bookkeeper to gaps.

steps.short: Gather hours, overtime, shift allowances and absence from sites and systems into the monthly payroll input.
steps.what: Build labour-cost summaries per site for finance
reasons: hands off to Controller, another team
steps.design: Replace the monthly Excel input sheet with a scheduled Python job on the governed data platform. It pulls approved hours and absence from AFAS and agency hours files from the three portals. It applies the CAO overtime and shift allowance rules from explicit, versioned tables and stages the variable pay lines. After the specialist approves the staged batch, the job posts it to AFAS through an UpdateConnector. A Power BI page shows labour cost per site, own staff versus flex, for the controller.

steps.short: Design and run development programmes that grow warehouse and office staff into team lead and management roles.
steps.what: Track progress and evaluate the programme at group level

loop.input: Free-text participant and manager feedback
loop.output: Themes with counts at group level
loop.check: Specialist reads a sample per theme; no individual scores, never fed into appraisals
loop.stop: One clustering pass per evaluation round; groups under five people are not reported
loop.why_not_simpler: Open comments cannot be counted by rules; the rest (attendance, promotions, retention) is plain reporting.

steps.design: Keep selection and delivery human. Use Studytube AI Authoring and a drafting step in Microsoft 365 to produce programme outlines and modules from the competence profile, and a Power BI page that follows participants' completion, promotion and retention at group level with a comment-clustering step for feedback. A feedback-practice copilot can support new team leads, disclosed as AI.

steps.short: Decide which job analysis tools are needed and build questionnaires, interview guides and description templates.
steps.what: Draft four-factor questionnaire, interview guide and description template

loop.input: The four factors (skills, responsibilities, effort, working conditions), the CAO job system and the current templates
loop.output: Draft questions and template sections, each tagged with a factor
loop.check: Every factor has questions; a checklist rejects salary-history and protected-trait questions; the specialist edits
loop.stop: Two revisions at most; then manual editing
loop.why_not_simpler: The questions need plain Dutch wording for each job group, which a fixed template cannot give

steps.design: A Power BI page on the AFAS extract and SharePoint metadata shows which jobs lack a current description or four-factor evaluation. A bounded model loop drafts questionnaires and templates tagged by factor, and Microsoft Forms collects the answers into a SharePoint list. The specialist and the works council settle the criteria.

steps.short: Plan, build and run training on pay policy, CAO scales, benefits and pay transparency for managers and HR.
steps.what: Draft slides, e-learning and quick-reference sheets
reasons: hands off to Learning and Development Specialist

loop.input: SharePoint policies, CAO articles and the training plan
loop.output: Slide outline, quiz questions and a one-page guide in Dutch
loop.check: Every rule cites a policy or CAO article; the specialist checks figures and legal points
loop.stop: Two revisions; then manual editing
loop.why_not_simpler: Turning policy text into plain teaching material is a writing task

steps.design: A bounded model loop turns SharePoint pay policies, CAO articles and the pay transparency rules into draft slides, quizzes and one-page guides, with a citation for each rule. Studytube is set up to enrol managers, recruiters and HRBPs automatically from AFAS and to report completions. The specialist runs the live sessions at the three sites.

steps.short: Set depreciation on new assets and advise management on buying, leasing or disposing of trucks, forklifts and racking.
steps.what: Analyse buy, lease or dispose options with cost and usage data
