steps.design: Configure AFAS fixed assets with a maintained asset policy table so useful lives and monthly depreciation run without Excel. A bounded model step proposes capitalise-or-expense and asset class for invoice lines, and a deterministic lease-versus-buy calculator on the data platform reads asset register, maintenance costs and offers to produce a standard analysis for management.

steps.short: Write specifications for HR reports and dashboards: purpose, measures, sources, filters and access.
steps.what: Document source fields and lineage from the AFAS extract
steps.design: A script reads the Power BI semantic model (field names, measures, descriptions) and writes a data dictionary to SharePoint on each deployment; a bounded loop turns intake notes into a spec draft on the standard template, and Copilot in Power BI drafts DAX that the analyst tests. Access and privacy sections stay the analyst's call, signed off by the HR Director.

steps.short: Write specifications for HR reports and dashboards: purpose, measures, sources, filters and access.
steps.what: Set access, minimum group size and check OR and privacy rules
steps.design: A script reads the Power BI semantic model (field names, measures, descriptions) and writes a data dictionary to SharePoint on each deployment; a bounded loop turns intake notes into a spec draft on the standard template, and Copilot in Power BI drafts DAX that the analyst tests. Access and privacy sections stay the analyst's call, signed off by the HR Director.

steps.short: Analyse pay, job and sector data and supply figures to management, sector bodies and government.
steps.what: Pull salary, FTE, grade and gender data from AFAS and agencies
reasons: connects AFAS Profit + Staffing agency portals
steps.design: Replace the Excel workbooks that join AFAS payroll and agency pay files with a scheduled Python/SQL job on the governed data platform. It builds a pay data mart and Power BI pages for gap per category, CAO costing and headcount. A bounded loop drafts replies to data requests around query-filled tables, and the specialist explains gaps and approves anything that leaves the company.

steps.short: Build and roll out training on energy, fuel, waste separation and recycling for warehouse, transport and office staff.
steps.what: Measure completion and effect on waste, energy and fuel
steps.design: Draft modules and toolbox cards in Studytube AI Authoring from the site procedures on SharePoint, with translated versions for non-Dutch-speaking shift and flex staff, and a SharePoint approval flow for the site lead's sign-off. Studytube audience rules fed by AFAS function and site enrol people automatically, and a Power BI page puts completion next to site waste and fuel figures at site level.

steps.short: Design and revise pay, promotion and appraisal methods, test their effects, and explain them to managers and staff.
steps.what: Draft a revised method: merit matrix, promotion criteria, job evaluation factors

loop.input: Current policy, CAO clauses, effect analysis and the specialist's chosen options
loop.output: Draft policy text with a change log against the current version
loop.check: Specialist reads every clause; a deterministic check confirms cited CAO articles and scale numbers exist in the source
loop.stop: One draft plus up to two revisions per request; otherwise the specialist writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: Policy text must be written from free-text sources and options; templates alone do not cover new methods

steps.design: A nightly job on a governed data platform joins the AFAS extract already used for Power BI with Recruitee offers and Studytube completions, and feeds a Power BI page showing raises, promotions and offer acceptance per grade, site and gender. A bounded drafting step turns the specialist's chosen options and the CAO text into policy and guide drafts in Word on SharePoint; consultation and consent stay with people.

steps.short: Run the yearly appraisal and merit cycle and check ratings and raises for unequal treatment.
steps.what: Check ratings and raises by gender, age, site and contract type
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Move the appraisal and merit round from mailed Excel files into AFAS Profit workflows and forms, with reminders handled by the workflow. A deterministic job on the AFAS extract computes rating and raise distributions per group and flags outliers in Power BI before calibration, and fills a fixed report template for the HR director and works council. No model is needed at run time.

steps.short: Run the yearly budget and steer planning and procurement across three sites and departments.
steps.what: Set budget calendar and send templates to site and department heads
steps.design: Replace the e-mailed Excel templates with a small budget entry app on the data platform, with automated reminders by Teams and a consolidation that is always current. A Power BI view shows variance against prior year and drivers, a bounded model step drafts questions for flagged lines, and the approved budget loads into AFAS by API.

steps.short: Prepare monthly and annual statements, management reports, forecasts, budgets and filings like VAT, CBS and KVK.
steps.what: Extract trial balance, subledgers and close entries from AFAS
steps.design: Move the close workbook to scheduled SQL/Python on a governed data platform fed by the AFAS extract and Rabobank CAMT.053 files: it builds statements, runs the tie-outs and publishes a Power BI close page. A bounded model step drafts commentary only after the tie-out is green; VAT stays in AFAS and the KVK SBR filing runs through filing software or the auditor, since AFAS cannot file it for large companies.

steps.short: Prepare monthly and annual statements, management reports, forecasts, budgets and filings like VAT, CBS and KVK.
steps.what: Tie out bank, AR, AP, payroll and intercompany between sites
steps.design: Move the close workbook to scheduled SQL/Python on a governed data platform fed by the AFAS extract and Rabobank CAMT.053 files: it builds statements, runs the tie-outs and publishes a Power BI close page. A bounded model step drafts commentary only after the tie-out is green; VAT stays in AFAS and the KVK SBR filing runs through filing software or the auditor, since AFAS cannot file it for large companies.

steps.short: Build org charts, career path tables and pay analysis reports on jobs, grades and pay.
steps.what: Draw org charts and career path tables per job family
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads the nightly AFAS extract, computes band position, compa-ratios and gaps per job group, site and gender, and renders org charts and career path tables; Power BI shows the results with row-level security. A bounded drafting step writes commentary checked number by number, and the report is a live Power BI page instead of a mailed file. The same pipeline produces the yearly pay transparency figures, with agency pay data added from the agency portals.

steps.short: Build org charts, career path tables and pay analysis reports on jobs, grades and pay.
steps.what: Compute compa-ratios, band position and pay gaps by group
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads the nightly AFAS extract, computes band position, compa-ratios and gaps per job group, site and gender, and renders org charts and career path tables; Power BI shows the results with row-level security. A bounded drafting step writes commentary checked number by number, and the report is a live Power BI page instead of a mailed file. The same pipeline produces the yearly pay transparency figures, with agency pay data added from the agency portals.

steps.short: Manage pension, absence, WIA and liability insurance premiums, track rule changes and budget benefit costs.
steps.what: Track changes in pension law (Wtp), WIA/WGA, ZW and premium rates
reasons: hands off to Compensation and Benefits Specialist, another team

loop.input: new items from Belastingdienst, UWV, pension fund and broker sources
loop.output: short digest with impact on Noordhaven schemes and budget
loop.check: each item links its source; controller or C&B marks relevance
loop.stop: monthly batch, max 20 items, unclear items flagged not summarised
loop.why_not_simpler: the sources are free text and the impact depends on which schemes apply

steps.design: A shared mailbox feeds a Python job on the governed data platform that extracts premium notes into a premium register, reconciles them nightly against AFAS payroll deductions and ledger accounts, and queues differences. A monthly model digest of UWV, Belastingdienst and pension fund changes goes to the controller and C&B, and the budget is calculated by code from the FP&A headcount plan.

steps.short: Work out Noordhaven's corporate tax and VAT positions, depreciation differences and the tax provision each quarter and year-end.
steps.what: Write tax workpaper and hand to controller and external tax adviser
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform pulls the AFAS trial balance, asset register and VAT ledgers through the AFAS API, computes the fiscal adjustment schedule by fixed rules, and runs one bounded classification pass over unclear cost lines. It generates the tax workpaper in a fixed template on SharePoint; the accountant judges positions and signs, and AFAS Jonas is used for its checks when filing the returns.

steps.short: Review AFAS, bank and agency-portal processes and recommend controls that keep financial data reliable.
steps.what: Agree actions with controller and chase follow-up
steps.design: Nightly deterministic tests on the governed data platform run over every AFAS mutation, payment batch, CAMT.053 statement and agency invoice (segregation of duties, IBAN changes, duplicates, unmatched agency hours) and feed a Power BI exception dashboard. Findings are drafted by a bounded model step and tracked in a SharePoint list; walkthroughs and the advice stay with the accountant.

steps.short: Compile monthly and ad hoc personnel reports from AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and agency exports in Excel.
steps.what: Write short commentary on changes and outliers

loop.input: month-on-month figures and threshold breaches computed deterministically
loop.output: three to six plain sentences per section
loop.check: every number in the text must match the dataset (automatic string check); no health or individual data in the prompt
loop.stop: one draft, one regeneration if the number check fails, otherwise blank section for the person
loop.why_not_simpler: Fixed sentence templates cover the routine cases; a model only helps when several changes need to be put together in one explanation.

steps.design: Replace the monthly Excel workbook that combines AFAS, Recruitee, Studytube and agency exports with scheduled extract jobs into the governed data platform behind the existing Power BI model. Standard reports become Power BI pages with row-level security per site, and a bounded model step drafts commentary that the administrator checks before a subscription sends the report.

steps.short: Run and check the month-end trial balance in AFAS before handing it to the accountant and controller.
steps.what: Hand trial balance to accountant and controller
steps.design: A scheduled job on the AFAS extract runs a close checklist daily in the last week: postings complete, suspense and intercompany balances zero, balances within expected ranges, and sends a Teams status to the bookkeeper and controller. Flagged accounts get a bounded loop that explains the cause and drafts a balancing correction, which the bookkeeper posts or rejects in AFAS.

steps.short: Report on asset use and audit results to management and recommend changes.
steps.what: Write the report and recommendations

loop.input: utilisation figures, trends and findings status
loop.output: draft commentary per site and per finding
loop.check: tie-out of every figure in the text to the dashboard; flagged mismatches block release
loop.stop: two drafts; then manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: the commentary explaining causes is free text

steps.design: A nightly job joins the AFAS fixed asset register with ledger and fleet or forklift usage data and feeds a Power BI page on use, idle assets and book value per site. Audit findings move from a mail-and-Excel log into a SharePoint list with owners and due dates, and a bounded model step drafts the commentary with a tie-out gate.

steps.short: Run job evaluation: describe jobs, score them in the function system, set the scale, handle objections.
steps.what: Check cost and equal-pay effects for current job holders
steps.design: Configure an AFAS workflow for evaluation requests with the description attached, and add a bounded model step that rewrites descriptions into the template and lists nearest reference jobs, without scoring. A Power BI page shows the cost and pay-gap effect of a proposed grade; the committee scores, and AFAS generates the letter after approval.

steps.short: When shippers stay silent, put them on credit hold, inform sales, and hand files to agency or lawyer.
steps.what: Put customer on credit hold and inform sales and operations
steps.design: An escalation workflow on the data platform flags accounts that finished the reminder sequence, proposes a credit hold that the officer approves and that notifies sales and planning in Teams. For accounts the officer sends on, it builds the hand-over file from AFAS and SharePoint with code-calculated interest and costs and a cited model chronology, checks the agency's Wki registration, and tracks case status.

steps.short: When shippers stay silent, put them on credit hold, inform sales, and hand files to agency or lawyer.
steps.what: Send file to agency or lawyer and track the outcome
steps.design: An escalation workflow on the data platform flags accounts that finished the reminder sequence, proposes a credit hold that the officer approves and that notifies sales and planning in Teams. For accounts the officer sends on, it builds the hand-over file from AFAS and SharePoint with code-calculated interest and costs and a cited model chronology, checks the agency's Wki registration, and tracks case status.

steps.short: Review aging and collection reports to see overdue balances, DSO and which debtors need action.
steps.what: Decide escalations: credit stop, legal, provision
steps.design: Replace the weekly Excel aging pack with a Power BI collections page on the nightly AFAS extract, showing DSO, overdue by debtor and site, and dispute status. A bounded model step labels debtor mails in the shared collections mailbox, and the officer confirms the label before it goes into AFAS. A notification flags debtors that cross a set threshold to the director.

steps.short: Keep org charts, the employee handbook, directories and evaluation forms current after changes in AFAS, the CAO or policy.
steps.what: Adjust performance evaluation forms and templates
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: Org charts and directories are generated each night from the AFAS org structure, either in Power BI or through the Microsoft 365 directory, so they are no longer kept by hand. Handbook changes run as a SharePoint approval flow: a bounded model step drafts a redline from the CAO or policy change, the HRBP approves it, and publishing and the Teams notice are automatic.

steps.short: Build the year-end tax pack from AFAS for the outside tax advisor, then review and approve returns.
steps.what: Gather supporting documents and answer advisor questions by mail
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads the AFAS trial balance, ledger detail and asset register, applies a versioned fiscal mapping table and builds the fiscal reconciliation and tax pack in a fixed SharePoint folder. A bounded model step proposes fiscal categories only for lines on mixed-cost accounts; the controller reviews those and lines above materiality, and filing stays with the advisor after sign-off.

steps.short: Gather actuals, prior budgets and site estimates into the budget workbook for FP&A.
steps.what: Send the budget pack to FP&A and answer their questions
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads the AFAS general ledger and prior budget, applies a maintained account-to-budget-line mapping and writes the budget pack to SharePoint. Site estimates come in through a Microsoft Forms or Power Apps entry screen with reminders, and a bounded model step drafts variance notes from site comments for the bookkeeper to check before FP&A gets the pack.

steps.short: Prepare and file VAT and ICP returns, statistics and agency liability papers to Belastingdienst and others.
steps.what: Archive filings, reconcile the VAT account, answer tax office questions
steps.design: Use the VAT and ICP reporting and digital submission already in AFAS, and add a scheduled rule job that flags suspicious VAT lines, with a bounded model step that proposes a code from the invoice text for the bookkeeper to accept. A small tracker on SharePoint or the data platform requests and records agency payment-behaviour statements and checks each agency payment batch for the g-rekening split, alerting the bookkeeper to gaps.

steps.short: Check that AFAS payroll deductions are booked right, reconciled and paid to tax office and pension fund.
steps.what: Investigate differences: retro corrections, CAO changes, leavers
reasons: hands off to Payroll Specialist, another team

loop.input: difference lines with employee-level payroll mutations of the period
loop.output: likely cause per difference (retro, timing, rate, error) with the matching mutations
loop.check: proposed cause must reference mutations whose amounts sum to the difference; otherwise marked unexplained
loop.stop: one pass per difference, unexplained ones go to payroll
loop.why_not_simpler: causes are spread over mutation notes and free-text remarks that rules cannot match

steps.design: AFAS keeps computing deductions; a scheduled SQL/Python job on the AFAS extract ties the payroll journal, loonaangifte, pension invoice and ledger to zero each run and shows breaks on a Power BI page. A bounded model step proposes causes for breaks from payroll mutations, and the Rabobank payment batch is released only when the tie-out is green and the controller approves.

steps.short: Complete, check and send pension, UWV and insurance forms, and record them for employees.
steps.what: Answer queries from fund, UWV or employee
steps.design: An AFAS Profit workflow takes in benefit forms. A bounded extraction step reads incoming documents into fields, and deterministic code checks them against AFAS records. Periodic pension data goes out through AFAS's standard pension interface (UPA) wherever the fund supports it. The specialist approves each external submission, and filing in the dossier happens automatically.

steps.short: Track how HR's internal customers (site and team managers) use HR reports and where their hiring and flex demand is rising.
steps.what: Answer follow-up questions from HRBPs and managers
reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner
steps.design: A scheduled Python job on Fabric pulls the Power BI activity log, Recruitee vacancies and agency flex orders nightly and joins them to AFAS org units. A Power BI demand dashboard flags thresholds (vacancy open over 30 days, flex hours up 20%) and a weekly Teams post with a checked short narrative goes to each HRBP. Report usage is shown per site or team, never per named manager.

steps.short: Pull HR data from AFAS and agency portals and prepare required reports and filings.
steps.what: Write explanation and caveats for each report

loop.input: report figures, prior period figures, definitions
loop.output: draft explanation of changes with caveats
loop.check: all numbers match the figures table; no statement on absence causes or individuals; groups under 10 people suppressed

loop.stop: two drafts; then the accountant writes it

reasons: hands off to HR Business Partner

A bounded model step drafts definition pages that the analyst approves, and the same definitions feed Copilot in Power BI so colleagues get answers without asking the analyst.
